articleTitle: Radio transmitters of Richard Sorge
abstract: The present paper concerns the system of information transfer from Japan to Vladivostok used during WWII by a Soviet secret service agent Richard Sorge, in a way of a simple tube radio.

articleTitle: Computer investigation of coaxial gyro-BWO efficiency depending on oscillator length
abstract: In this report we investigated efficiency dependence on length of space interaction under homogenous and profiling guiding magnetic field gyro-BWO.

articleTitle: The work M. Shuleikin for spark transmitter
abstract: The distinctive feature of constructions of spark radio stations involving the multiple Max Wien type spark gap are considered. Based on the studies by M. Shuleikin and I. Freiman it is shown that the power of this type of radio stations is related to the upper voltage level that can not.

articleTitle: The method of ultra-short pulse current-voltage and capacity-voltage characterization
abstract: The method of obtaining current-voltage (IVC) and capacity-voltage (CVC) characteristics of an element based at ultra-short baseband impact is considered. The impact can be shorter than duration of impulse response of an element.

articleTitle: On the effectiveness of an orbictron using the resonance groove in a mirror plane
abstract: The calculations of HF-fields in the open resonator (OR) of a THz-range orbictron have been performed. It is shown that, as the OR immobile mirror has a rectangular resonance groove on the bottom of which a binary comb is arranged, one can increase, with the same Q-factor, a HF-field amplitude in the region of the sheet electron beam, at least, by a factor of 6.

articleTitle: Extreme frequency characteristics of GaAs-based MESFET for a given geometry
abstract: The paper presents the basic theoretical principles on which the numerical model of GaAs-based MESFETs is based, and the main characteristics (CVC, response to a rectangular pulse) obtained by the developed model. To increase the productivity of the model, some steps of the calculations were performed on the GPU using NVIDIA CUDA technology.

articleTitle: High-power 95 GHz pulsed magnetrons
abstract: Two 95 GHz pulsed magnetrons with an output power 12 and 20 kW are described. They afford the improved performance characteristics through the use of a spatial harmonic mode and a cold second-electron emission cathode. The magnetron in question have been designed and development in IRA NAS of Ukraine.

articleTitle: SPACEflight — A versatile live demonstrator and teaching system for advanced service-oriented technologies
abstract: New research advances in loosely-coupled, uniformly described service-oriented systems continue to appear at a high rate. Application areas such as enterprise information systems, cloud computing and programmable web applications benefit from these developments. Yet, it is hard for researchers, developers and students to understand the combined effect of methodologies, which leads to unutilised opportunities to further accelerate the innovation. We present our proposed solution called SPACEflight. It is a free, ready-to-use demonstrator which contains a complete service platform, service engineering tools, extensions for cloud computing and service quality ensurance, and on top a user-friendly service-oriented desktop with tradeable scenario services.

articleTitle: The electrodynamical system of DRO-orbictron with doubled comb
abstract: The results obtained from optimizing the parameters of the electro-dynamic DRO-orbictron system with a periodic structure in the form of a binary comb placed in a rectangular groove on one of the open resonator (OR) mirror are presented. The rectangular groove acts as a quarter-wave transformer and is conductive to an increase in the resonance field amplitude in the transit channel between the combs. If the depth and the width of groove are chosen to be optimal, then the field of the operating TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00q</sub>-mode tends to shrink down to the groove and one can also observe a decrease in radiation losses during the effective de-excitation of higher-order modes in an OR.

articleTitle: The set of wideband directional antennas for systems of electromagnetic radiation locating
abstract: The design principles of a range of wideband directional antennas for systems of electromagnetic radiation location are considered. The results of the development and testing of loaded loop antennas, planar log-periodic and slot expanding ones, with a range of frequencies coverage from 20 MHz up to 3 GHz are described.

articleTitle: Simulation orboklystrons with sheet beams
abstract: Simulation of millimeter - and submillimeter oscillators has been performed. A mathematical orbotron-klystron (orboklystron) model is worked out, in which the space charge of a sheet electron beam and sagging of fields in gaps are considered. It is shown that the calculated electron efficiency of orboklystrons operating at 50 and 300 GHz may come up to 30 and 4% respectively.

articleTitle: Local oscillator channel for radio relay system in 130–134 GHz band
abstract: LO channel has been designed for digital transceiver system operating in the frequency band of 130-134 GHz. The possibility to have output power 10 mW at frequency of 64.8 GHz with phase noise level - 80 dB at 1 kHz detuning is shown. Output frequency multiplier stage of LO channel was made and examined experimentally.

articleTitle: The brief history of CriMiCo: (A commemorative essay dedicated to the 20th anniversary of the first convocation of the above conference)
abstract: An outline of events and milestones is presented describing the history of the International Conference on «Microwave Engineering and Telecommunication Technologies» (CriMiCo). The primary gathering of this forum is dated on 1991. The location where it was convened is the world-famous city of Sevastopol (the Crimea, Ukraine). Below are listed the activities of the conference over a span of the first decade, the evolution of the Conference chapter formats in the second decade, the specific facets of seminars, workshops and panel groups. In addition, a special emphasis is placed upon the framework in which the conference initiatives had been undertaken, upon the distinctive features of the specific work the relevant committees were involved in. Mention is to be made of the conference awards and bonuses granted to merited participants. Eventually, another no less important event took place when the president of the NASU academician Boris Paton and the Ministry of Education and Science professor Dmytro Ta-bachnik had welcomed this representative gathering. That was a sheer evidence of its recognition as a major advance in developing science and engineering. In the appendices that follow a good deal of space is given to some significant statistical facts. There had been an impressive series of paper submissions from 772 universities and enterprises at 20 conferences. References are made to the countries that got involved in this grand forum, to the well-known research centers as well as to the activity of young scientists and experts. Besides, the reader is sure to find some brief information on 86 members of the Organizing and Program Committees that were actively engaged in sponsoring and conducting this conference.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband heterostructural monolithic microwave pin-diode switches
abstract: This paper presents the results of development microwave monolithic integrated circuits (MMIC's) of ultra-wideband switches based on heterostructure p-i-n-diodes.

articleTitle: Problems and perspectives of development of nanoradio based on carbon nanotubes
abstract: The problems of development of radio receivers based on carbon nanotubes were analyzed. The main perspective ways of solution to address emerging issues were identified.

articleTitle: Thin dielectric resonators for microwave characterization of films and substrates
abstract: Thin dielectric resonator consisting only of a low-loss dielectric substrate and a deposited film is proposed for the electrode-free microwave characterization of thin films and substrates. In-plane microwave dielectric parameters of a number of substrates and thin films were measured in a broad temperature range using the TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01δ</sub> resonance mode. Dielectric anomalies corresponding to the induced phase transitions were observed. The HE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11δ</sub> mode is proposed for the in-plane dielectric anisotropy characterization. The anisotropy of the (110) DyScO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> substrate was measured.

articleTitle: Account of inheritable characteristics in terms of complex technological optimization of MMIC
abstract: The task solution of complex technological optimization of MMIC is considered as an interrelated choice of a probability of given functions fulfillment in a group of MMIC within time, acceptable deviations of output electric parameters (setting indices), a probability of output yields and guaranteed resource of a consignment and individual samples of MMIC in framework of existing technologies. In order to account correlation links in MMIC design the elements of technological inheritance theory are used.

articleTitle: Improving Microsoft Hyper-V Live Migration efficiency over distance
abstract: When using virtualization environments the overall application availability can be significantly improved in planned or unplanned scenarios. The Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization technology is an important mean toward this end and the Live Migration process presents fault tolerance, load balancing, and disaster recovery to the next level.

articleTitle: Influence of attenuation fluctuations of the super-regenerative transciver on parameters of the reception mode
abstract: The influence of starting current fluctuations of the super-regenerative transceiver on the pass-band and sensitivity in a reception mode is observed. 1. The parameters of a reception mode — sensitivity and pass-band are defined by the law of change of attenuation of a contour, near a boundary value. 2. The influence of starting current fluctuations on statistical characteristics of attenuation of oscillatory system near boundary current values on the basis of the linear approach of the regenerative characteristic is defined. 3. The influence of starting current fluctuations on statistical characteristics of oscillatory system attenuation near the values of boundary current on the basis of the linear approach of the regenerative characteristics, is defined. 4. The minimum width of a pass-band and the maximum sensitivity is defined by the law of distribution of the starting current, which an average value to equally boundary current.

articleTitle: Modeling of artifacts at the current-voltage characteristics of the resonant tunneling diode
abstract: The method of accounting of artifacts at I-V characteristics of a resonant tunneling diode (RTD) was proposed within envelope function formalism. The idea of a method is to introduce a “virtual” reservoir that can emit an electron through a definite barrier to the emitter quantum well (EQW), from which electrons can tunnel through the main quantum well (MQW) through the whole quantum region.

articleTitle: Russian part in organization and work of CriMiCo conferences (1991–2010)
abstract: Analyzed in this paper is participation of Russian scientists and specialists in organization and work of International Crimean Conferences “Microwave & Telecommunication Technology” in 1991–2010, taking into consideration four aspects: publications, participation in committees' work (personalia of 34 scientists and specialists), organization of committees' work in Moscow and Moscow suburbs, contribution of Russian female scientists into the Conference development. The method of bibliometric analysis was used.

articleTitle: X-band amplifier on GaN qmic with output power of 20 W
abstract: In this paper the development results of GaN quasi-monolithic IC (QMIC) of preliminary and output X-band amplifiers and open-frame hybrid-integral amplifier module with output power of 20 W based on it are presented. The construction and characteristics of QMIC are shown.

articleTitle: Radar imaging software system for multi-modal SAR validation
abstract: Special SAR imaging software is developed for calibration and validation tasks. Compression for various impulse waveforms is provided.

articleTitle: On the issue of solving the diffraction problem of radioacoustic atmospheric sounding by bistatic systems
abstract: Using the method of radioacoustic atmospheric sounding is limited due to the absence of the satisfactory solution of the problem of electromagnetic field diffraction on a pack of acoustic waves. The accurate solution is quite awkward. The report presents an approximate approach that is verified by experiment.

articleTitle: 6 Watt 6–18 GHz broadband power amplifier
abstract: The results of the development and the experimental investigation of (6–18) GHz range of a broadband transistor amplifier with output power in continuous mode 6 Watt at 2 dB gain compression are presented. The experimental characteristics with different transistors, design features and assembly technology of the manufactured amplifiers are discussed.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of radiation characteristics of cylindrical helical antennas
abstract: In this paper a comparative analysis of the regular cylindrical spiral antenna (CSA) characteristics and non-regular cylindrical spiral antenna with a variable angle of winding (NCSA) is presented. Calculations were performed for Ku-band.

articleTitle: Numerical conformal transformations technique for analysis of the microstrip structures
abstract: New aspects of computer realization of the stripline structures analysis technique based on using numerical conformal transformations are developed. The stated approach is characterized by high numerical efficiency and sufficient accuracy for practice.

articleTitle: Routing in wireless networks with creating disjoint multipath topology on the basis of the force lines of potential field
abstract: The report represents a method of routing and estimation of power consumption in wireless sensor networks and telecommunication networks. The description is given for the mathematical model of routing. The suggestion is made about how to take into account different network parameters and to calculate new routes in case of interference presence in the net while modeling a network.

articleTitle: Investigation of temperature and frequency dependences of dielectric characteristics of bulk dielectrics and semiconductors
abstract: Investigation of some dielectric and semiconductor materials in the millimeter waveband and temperature range from helium to room temperature is carried out. The technique using the open disk resonator with whispering gallery modes was used. The character of the behavior of permittivity and loss tangent of materials is determined. Comparative analysis of the results is performed.

articleTitle: Spark resistance affect to performance of tesla transformer
abstract: Tesla transformer (TT) operation is denoted by losses in primary circuit. The spark resistance of gas switch and its affect to TT performance are studied both experimentally and theoretically.

articleTitle: Development of microwave filters in range from 1 TO 4 GHz on LTCC ceramics FSUE RPC “Istok”
abstract: In the article the results of development of independent devices based on in-house LTCC ceramics of Federal State Unitary Enterprise "Research & Production Corporation "Istok" in a solid version on the example of band-pass filters as the most often needed products for different kinds of signal conversion are presented. The main parameters of in-house LTCC ceramics of Federal State Unitary Enterprise "Research & Production Corporation "Istok" and analogous brands of ceramics of world's leading manufacturers are briefly reported.

articleTitle: Mobile communication system capacity increasing with spectrum spreading by means of space-time matched signal reception
abstract: The results of the analysis of possible using of space-time matched signal reception for access establishing to mobile communication systems and its capacity increasing, also comparison of capacity of systems with temporal and space-time matched signal reception are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: A new technique for synthesis of low noise amplifiers based on genetic algorithm and morphological approach
abstract: A new technique for automatic synthesis of linear and low noise amplifiers (LNAs) based on genetic algorithm and morphological approach is presented. The technique is implemented in the software tool GENEAMP. Efficiency of automatic synthesis is demonstrated in example design of 0.01–7 GHz single-stage feedback LNA.

articleTitle: Radiometry of microwave range in medical-biological and other appliances
abstract: Issues of the usage of radiometry in mm-range for the studying of the human body's own radiation, electromagnetic properties of certain materials, metrological provision of special medical equipment are considered. The possibility and prospects of application of radiometry for analysis of parameters of low-intensity signals of objects of animate and inanimate nature are shown.

articleTitle: Optimization of operating regimes of TWT three-electrode electron gun
abstract: The numerical calculations based on FIT-method of a three-electrode electron gun were made. Optimal potentials of the electrodes which are necessary to obtain a low-energy intensive axially symmetric electron beam were defined as well.

articleTitle: Generation of chaotic oscillations in elements of nonlinear radars
abstract: The article concerns the implications of the plot with a negative differential resistance in current-voltage characteristics of silicon diode structures under the influence of a relatively high level of a microwave power probe signal of a nonlinear radar. The possibility of registering non-linear radar spurious harmonics of random generators in the facility study is theoretically justified. It is shown that the random generator can also emit chaotic oscillations, which can be regarded as information to identify the embedded device by means of a nonlinear radar. The use of two additional modes of identification devices embedded in a nonlinear radar is proposed: on a multiple harmonic and by the presence of chaotic signals, which greatly improves the efficiency of the nonlinear radar in the technical protection of information.

articleTitle: Dynamics of weak continuous quantum measurement were based on information approach
abstract: The constraints of formalism of clear-cut instantaneous quantum measurements for a series of experiments were addressed. The shortcomings of existing approaches to modeling weak continuous quantum measurements (WCQM) were analyzed. It is shown that they can be replaced with an equivalent information approach, in which mechanism for obtaining information, is not essential and the dynamics of the observed system depends only on the information of the generalized measurement parameters. The experiment on observing the Rabi oscillations in a solid phase quantum bit is described. The equation for calculating the energy spectrum of the random process related to such measurements is derived.

articleTitle: Monopulse irradiator for system with digital shaping of reception directional pattern
abstract: The development results of a monopulse antenna irradiator for a system with digital shaping of reception directional pattern of a millimeter wave band working on waves with circular polarization are presented. Scheme and main advantages of the developed construction are described.

articleTitle: Influence of AlGaN/GaN 2D-channel linear dimensions of drain-to-source field GaN transistor on its instrument characteristics (effect of lateral dimensions)
abstract: It was shown [1, 2] that in the local approximation fractal properties of 2D-electron gas AlGaN/GaN of het-erostructures, determining the dependence of resistance per unit length ρ on length l and width d of the HEMT-transistor drain-to-source channel, significantly influence on its instrument characteristics: drain-to-source resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SD</inf>, thermal breakdown resistance U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</inf> and transconductance G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">M</inf>. It indicates that it is necessary consider fractal properties of the material during the engineering of high-power HEMT-transistors on Al-GaN/GaN. As it follows from obtained results, maximum values of instrument characteristics for material with smaller values of local approximation limits L can be obtained with smaller linear dimensions of transistor active elements.

articleTitle: Coaxial calibration metrics
abstract: Coaxial standard devices of open-circuit, short-circuit and matched load were developed. Such devices are used in calibration kit of the measurement technology.

articleTitle: Omnidirectional printed patch collinear antenna arrays of vertical polarization
abstract: The article describes omnidirectional printed patch collinear antenna arrays of vertical polarization. The examples of 5 and 7 elements are given. The results of models of computer simulation are compared with experimental data. The novelty is to apply this kind of antennae in X-band.

articleTitle: Anormal errors of phase incursion and frequency shift measurements for microwaves and methods to reduce them
abstract: It has been established that anormal errors may appear during phase difference measurements by the rectangular waves method. The ways to reduce these errors are suggested. The most universal way is one based on maximum a posteriori probabilities.

articleTitle: Harmonic radiosource phase coordinate determination radiosystem for operating in Fresnel zone
abstract: The unused potentials for harmonic signal radio-source (RS) coordinate determination in the existing phase direction-finders (PDF) with sparse antenna arrays in the Fresnel zone are shown. The approaches and scheme realizations for phase coordinate determination of radiosystems (PCDR) to estimate the bearing angle, the tilt angle for plane and spherical phase fronts and distance estimation to RS when electromagnetic wave's phase front curvature is proposed.

articleTitle: Wireless UWB ecologically friendly communications at 70 nanowatt radiation power
abstract: UWB ecologically friendly communication link at 70 nanowatt transmit power is proposed for wireless personal area networks. The electromagnetic compatibility and transmit covertness performances are presented.

articleTitle: X-band printed antenna array
abstract: The development results of an X-band printed antenna array scheme are presented. Radiating aperture and independent horizontal and vertical power dividing systems are made at single multilayer printed circuit board.

articleTitle: Informational and computational resourses of Internet-portal «strength of materials» integration
abstract: The present paper describes an approach to the internet portal in the strength of materials designing. The process of analysis and modeling of business processes of the portal is described.

articleTitle: Base station synchronization for application of IP networks
abstract: The basic principles of the time and frequency synchronization for modern networks are considered. Mobile Base Station synchronization is very important problem in IP-networks.

articleTitle: Development of an omni-directional semicircular disk antenna with improved ultra-wideband performance
abstract: A method for broadening the frequency range of a UWB omni-directional semicircular disk antenna designed before is presented. By adding several flexible metal poles at both ends of the antenna, the lowest frequency can extend to 0.18GHz compared with the former value of 0.35GHz. When the frequency range concerned starts from 0.35GHz or higher, these poles can be pulled back for a compact configuration. The novel antenna is considerably promising in UWB electromagnetic investigation and other fields.

articleTitle: 15 Watt C-X band broadband power amplifier
abstract: The results of development and an experimental investigation of (4…12) GHz range of Q-MMIC transistor amplifier with output power 13–18 Watt are presented. The experimental characteristics, design featuresand assembly technology of the manufactured amplifiers are discussed.

articleTitle: On efficiency and power enhancement in 700 GHz BWO
abstract: The possibility of minimization of BWO's power consumption is considered in simulation and experimental ways. It is demonstrated that geometrical optimization of the slow-wave structure and BWO with a depressed collector is able to decrease the power consumption significantly.

articleTitle: The modes of omnidirectional circular polarized radiation of four-wire helix antenna
abstract: The present paper describes the possibility to produce different modes of omnidiractional field circular - polarized radiation using a four-wire helix antenna.

articleTitle: Application of OFDM modulation for radiotelephone transmission identification in the maritime radiocommunication
abstract: OFDM modulation is proposed for application in data embedding algorithms in the maritime VHF radiotelephony. Experiments are carried out for signal transmission in the real VHF radio channel for off-line processing in MatLab. The rates of 4 bit/sec for simple algorithm and 40 bit/sec for algorithm considering information about audio carrier signal in the transmitter are obtained in the standard 300÷3000 Hz band. The design method is intended for implementation of radiotelephone transmissions automatic identification in maritime communication without standard radio equipment replacing, additional frequency-time resources allocation and altering the adopted radio communication procedures.

articleTitle: Multi-sectional Tesla transformer
abstract: Aspects of design of a multi-sectional Tesla transformer (MTT) presented as a system with three primaries are discussed. Calculation and experimental characteristics of MTT, and its advantages (lower currents in the primary, higher efficiency together with lower duration of the period) in comparison with traditional TT are shown.

articleTitle: Microstrip filters and diplexer for the receiver of the global navigation satellite systems «GLONASS», «GPS» and «GALILEO»
abstract: Microstrip passband filters with low losses in the passband for the low-noise amplifier and microstrip passband filters for the diplexer of the combined bandwidth receiver of the space navigation systems «GLONASS» and «GPS» have been developed. Microstrip passband filters of the combined bandwidth L2 + L3 for the systems «GPS» and «GALILEO» have also been designed. The filters are fabricated using quarter-wave microstrip resonators. The filters have been subjected to thermal tests at temperatures from plus 70 to minus 50 °C. The serial production of the filters has been started.

articleTitle: X-band GaAs pHEMT MMIC low-noise amplifier
abstract: This report presents results of design and manufacturing of X-band GaAs pHEMT low-noise amplifier. Operating frequency band is 8-12 GHz, gain is 30 dB, noise factor is 1.5 dB, P1dB output power is 10 dBm, unipolar supply voltage is +5 V, consumption current is 100 mA, and chip dimensions are 2.5×1.5×0.1 mm.

articleTitle: Digital antenna array for multifunctional on-board radar
abstract: The ways to construct the antenna arrays on the basis of technology of digital beamforming (DBF) for multifunctional on-board radar have been considered. The use of millimeter-wave radar in radiolocation might significantly improve the parameters of object recognition. The modern digital element base makes it possible to realize the technology of DBF in practice.

articleTitle: Synthesis of directional couplers having aperiodic band-pass on base of nonregular relief coupled strip structures
abstract: The synthesis of directional couplers with a non-periodical bandpass and suppression in the frequency dependence s<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub>(f) is realized. DC's are constructed on the basis of irregular relief coupled strip structures with orthogonally arranged substrates and conductors. Step-irregular structures are taken as a basic prototype.

articleTitle: Design and development of microwave virtual oscilloscope of complex reflectivity based on electromagnetic approach
abstract: A virtual oscilloscope of the complex reflection coefficient, based on the electromagnetic model of the E-plane cross-shaped power divider has been developed. Calibration consisted in grading the power indicators on the matched load,. using the calculated coefficients of the divider scattering matrix. When testing vibrating loads with the module of the reflection coefficient of 0.16, 0.59, 1.0, over the 8-millimeter wavelength range, the obtained error of the reflection coefficient was less than 5%.

articleTitle: Frequency tuning from pulse to pulse magnetron generator
abstract: A circuitry of discrete tuned magnetron generator from pulse to pulse has been considered. The circuitry has been implemented on two energy output 2-cm and 3-cm magnetrons with air cooling. A PIN diodes switcher is used for frequency control. The experimental curves of the magnetron frequency tuning are shown. The magnetron frequency tuning range is 300 MHz with an average output power of up to 25 W.

articleTitle: Microwave plasma torch at atmospheric pressure for food industry
abstract: The microwave plasma torch at atmospheric pressure with a power supply of 600 watts for food industry is designed. The calculation, optimization, tuning and investigation of a cavity of the working chamber plasma torch are conducted. Experimental investigation of microwave plasma torch is performed.

articleTitle: Estimation of hydration of oxyethylated derivatives of glycerol
abstract: Hydration number of molecules of oxyethylated glycerol (OEG) of polymerization degree n = 5, 25 and 30 has been determined by infrared spectroscopy method. According to the experimental results, an OEG<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n=5</sub> molecule is able to bind with about 20 water molecules, an OEG<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n=25</sub> molecule is able to bind with about 75 water molecules, and an OEG<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n=30</sub> molecule is able to bind with about 90 water molecules.

articleTitle: Impact ionization effective threshold energy estimation in MOSFET with 50-nm channel length
abstract: In the frame of Keldysh model the impact ionization effective threshold energy has been calculated for deep submicron silicon MOSFET by means of Monte-Carlo electron transport simulation. The possibility of the impact ionization rate description by one-parameter Keldysh model is shown.

articleTitle: Microwave image reconstruction with two antenna scan aperture synthesis
abstract: The microwave image reconstruction algorithm for two antenna scan aperture synthesis is described. Algorithm takes into account antennas spatial separation. Numerical and experimental investigations had shown algorithm efficiency.

articleTitle: Reflection of electromagnetic waves by a plane layer of biisotropic COMPOSITE MATERIAL
abstract: The problem on the interaction between the electromagnetic waves and the plane layer of a biisotropic composite material made of resistive fibers in the form of few-coil helices is solved. The influence of different parameters that characterize the composite on the reflective properties of the layer examined, located on a metallic plane, is examined.

articleTitle: Intelligent analysis of complex enqueries to relational DBMS
abstract: The paper introduces abilities of a developed general theory of multiplace relations in the intelligent analysis of complex relational enquiries, which can be expressed by logical formulas containing elementary unary and binary predicates without quantifiers.

articleTitle: About failure in multi service networks
abstract: Based on a framework of semi-Markov processes and a method of phase consolidation the model of failure-free multi service networks (MSN) was designed.

articleTitle: On the approaches to the clasification of computer-aided collection of information resurces
abstract: Two approaches taken to classifying the computer-aided collections of information resource: one — according to specialization (structure of metadata, specialization level, resource volume) and the other — in terms of belonging to the “knowledge base” category (presence/lack of relationships between the elements of a subject area and/or the interpretation functions) are presented. Examples illustrating both of the approaches are cited. The problems with the creation of strictly specialized computer-aided collections are considered.

articleTitle: Quasi-optical power splitters of millimeter wave range
abstract: The schemes and principles of operation of a quasi-optical power splitter on the base of two-row periodic structures, which are formed by metal rectangular section bar gratings, are described.

articleTitle: Highly efficient mode converters for smooth and corrugated circular waveguide
abstract: Using the methods of synthesis of waveguide components developed by the authors, a number of highly efficient and compact mode converters for smooth and corrugated oversized circular waveguides were calculated. High efficiency of the converters was proved in experiment.

articleTitle: Study of the modern society requirements in telecommunication services
abstract: The study of modern society requirements in telecommunication services by use of a method of individual polling is carried out. The polling defined time expenses of area inhabitants for use of the basic telecommunication services (the fixed telephony, access to the Internet, viewing of television programs); popularity of the basic telecommunication services; percentage distribution of interested persons will be connected to various Internet and digital television tariffs.

articleTitle: Modeling and organization of parallel computing in science and engineering research
abstract: The usage of high-performance computing technologies in the areas of scientific and engineering researches is considered in the article. The using of high-performance computing based on OpenMP library for solving tasks in the field of Telecommunication, e.g. computation of the queues QoS parameters, is also analyzed.

articleTitle: The contribution of evanescent waves into the field
abstract: It has been proved before that the Fourier spectrum of the field distribution in any plane is necessarily singular if only the far-field angular distribution in this plane is not equal to zero. The general expressions for contribution of evanescent waves are obtained and the difference between their contribution for continuous and singular spectra is shown.

articleTitle: ERS-1, European remote-sensing satellite was launched 20 years ago
abstract: Studies and predevelopments started in the early 80's for ERS, the first European remote-sensing satellite. ERS-1 was launched 17 July 1991. It has been operated until 10 March 2000. ERS-1 observed the Earth later on in tandem with ERS-2, (a similar satellite) which has been launched in 1995. Initially designed for maritime applications, these remote sensing satellites have produced very exciting results for land applications. Interferometry has been developed. ERS-2 is operated until end June 2011 clearly exceeding its operational lifetime. The paper recalls the satellite configuration with its antennas and results. Recently we had a “deviating“ observation with ERS-2 carried out on 12 April 2011 (50 years after Yu. Gagarin made as a first human a travel in space around the Earth), which will be described.

articleTitle: Dynamics of charge domains in semiconductor superlattice under external periodic interference
abstract: Effects of a periodic external signal on collective dynamics of charge in semiconductor superlattices have been studied. It has been shown that an external electric field is able to synchronize the transport of domains of high charge density, and thus electrical current through the superlattice. The synchronization phenomena are accompanied by the sharp increase of absorption on the frequency of external field, and manifest themselves in modification of current-voltage characteristics.

articleTitle: Modelling of processes of carry and electronic properties of heterostructures in the Internet
abstract: The description of Resource-intensive center of computation for designing through the Internet, its realization taking into account a choice of optimum means and modern Internet technologies is submitted. The complex is actively used in lecture courses and computer laboratory researches within the limits of the disciplines connected with designing and modeling in microelectronics.

articleTitle: Estimation of anode current angular dependence in eccentric cylindrical diodes
abstract: The paper presents the theoretical analysis of the emitter location asymmetry influence upon the anode current angular dependence in a cylindrical diode.

articleTitle: Antennas solutions for Mobile Satellite Broadcasting (MSB)
abstract: In this paper are introduced the current solutions of antennas useful for application of Mobile Satellite Broadcasting (MSB). These types of antenna solutions are usually using onboard mobiles such as ships, vehicles (road and railway) and aircraft. In many respects these types of the antenna infrastructures currently available are designed to track the satellite, following both movements of mobiles and satellite orbital motions. Sometimes this is difficult and expensive to synchronize and have to be introduced in the understanding manner. The vehicular antennas for MSB are in fact directional antennas with high gain radiation and sophisticated tracking performances. The Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) and Non-GEO current and forthcoming MSB operators have conducted research on all network segments, including different types of antennas and their future development and improvements. The special types of MSB antenna related to the kind of transportation system, such as maritime, land, aeronautical are classified and discussed.

articleTitle: Ka-band low loss monolithic microwave GaAs SPST
abstract: Results of designing the GaAs SPST MMIC with dimensions of 2.0×1.0 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are presented. The IC provides maximum insertion loss at level 1 dB within 26.5–40 GHz frequency range.

articleTitle: The measuring system for research of homodyne measuring transducers parameters
abstract: The paper presents the results of creation of automatized measurement system for research of parameters of homodyne transducers. The main algorithms and methods of this system are presented. The experimental results are discussed.

articleTitle: Possibilities of calibration of polirimetric side-looking radars with synthetic aperture taking into account Faraday effect using natural area-extended targets
abstract: Possibilities of calibration of polirimetric side-looking radars with synthetic aperture (RSA) as per natural area-extended targets taking into account Faraday effect are analyzed. Algorithmic formulas allowing the compensation of radar apparatus distortions in the case of Faraday effect are given.

articleTitle: Investigation of SiC etch process in inductively coupled SF6/O2/Ar plasma
abstract: The plasma etching process of the SiC via hole fabrication is developed. In the course of the present work the correlation between etch rate and main process parameters, such as: pressure, RF power and gas flow was obtained. The final process shows the etching rate of more than 1000 nm/min during the etching process of the SiC substrate 100μm thick.

articleTitle: Nano-sized titanium silicide produced by combinating of mechanoactivation and self-diffusing high-temperature synthesis
abstract: The process of producing the semi-conductor titanium dissilicide through the combination of mechanoactivation and self-diffusing high-temperature synthesis is investigated.

articleTitle: Dynamic tools for visualization of citation networks extracted from the content of scientific portals
abstract: This paper describes new tools for dynamic visualization of citation networks generated from the content of large scientific portals. The first method is a dynamic version of the well-known layered algorithm. The second method generates edge bundles with respect to the obtained by the first algorithm drawing.

articleTitle: Mobile data traffic offloading by means of Wi-Fi technology
abstract: Possible options for reducing the data traffic through the base station are proposed. The recommendations on various options for uses of technology WI-FI networks of mobile operators are given. We consider two architectures to reduce the workload of the GSM network and the possibility of improving the performance of existing networks and obtain high economic returns without transition to next generation networks.

articleTitle: The reasons of deterioration of LTE signal. Comparison of bit error rate for different types of modulation
abstract: The present paper concerns the reasons of deterioration of LTE signal, key parameters of which should be considered at testing of user's terminals. The diagram of the transceiver of LTE technology for downlink frequency division duplex of channel with fading is considered. The diagram presents relation of bit error rate to noise ratio for different types of modulation.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic properties of a layered periodical fine-stratified structures with artificial anisotropy
abstract: Conical refraction phenomenon in a fine-stratified structure was investigated. The structure was fabricated by periodic alternating dielectric and semiconductor layers and was exposed into an external magnetic field. It has been shown that such structure represents a biaxial crystal. The dependences of aperture angle of an internal conical refraction cone as function of frequency, external magnetic fields and thickness of layers are analysed.

articleTitle: The design of an access network for triple play service
abstract: The main principles of construction of the multi-services networks are considered. The project of creation of the access network based on Sevastopol National Technical University infrastructure is offered.

articleTitle: Security issues in unified communications
abstract: Unified Communications have the potential to dramatically simplify and improve enterprise communications, reducing costs and improving revenue opportunities. However, these benefits do not come without risks. The introduction of an IP-based Unified Communications solution brings an array of new vulnerabilities into the enterprise, exploited by a growing number of malicious programs. The most common risks faced by the major dominant technologies used in unified communications solutions are presented and an approach to mitigate them is proposed.

articleTitle: Principles of constructing a mobile measuring complex for controlling parameters of electromagnetic compatibility
abstract: Principles of constructing the mobile measuring automated complex are proposed. It is shown that the hardware-software facilities providing a high level of automation of the basic processes of data measurement and processing the presence of shielded cabins, mobility and autonomy of the complex to solves efficiently the present-day problems associated metrological maintenance in controlling the parameters of electromagnetic radiations from radioelectronic systems.

articleTitle: Estimation of influence of antenna radome noise temperatures on images formed by matrix radiometric systems
abstract: The method of evaluation of radome heating influence on actual images formed by the matrix radiometric extreme-correlated system of aircraft navigation was developed. The method allows taking into account the layered pattern of radome and heating irregularity from layer to layer and in direction of a radome guiding line. The method takes into account the interference of frequency components of radiation in radome wall.

articleTitle: Draft design of hall, dedicated to history of development of radio technologies in Sevastopol and Crimea
abstract: In furtherance of a motion of a head of a department of radio engineering and telecommunication service of Sevastopol National Technical University professor Gimpilevich Yu. B. about placement in Sevastopol of a bust monument to founder of radio technologies A. S. Popov, the draft design of the hall in the main building of SevNTU, devoted to the history of development of radio technologies in the Crimea and Sevastopol with placement of the bust monument of the founder of radio technologies has been developed. General view of the hall is given.

articleTitle: Levels width in triple-barrier structures in two-photon transitions
abstract: For asymmetric triple-barrier resonant-tunneling structures with thin high barriers, the simple expressions describing resonant transitions in the large-signal high-frequency electric fields have been obtained taking into account levels width. It is shown that conditions exist for every structure, when the majority of electrons falling on the upper energy level can emit two photons and then leave the structure without any intermediate interaction. The number of regions without reflection can reach four.

articleTitle: Calculation of accelerator cell of electrons and positrons at the superconducting niobium cavity
abstract: The paper is devoted to calculations of accelerating section of a collider which consists of separate hollow cavities energized by microwave power. These cavities are used to accelerate electrons up to sublight velocities. A computer synthesis of forms of a cavity providing the required electrical characteristics was conducted. Promising single-cell cavity designs, which provide up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> Q at the operating frequency of 1.3 GHz, were found.

articleTitle: A slot radiator at an end wall of rectangular waveguide with a double-slot resonant diaphragm
abstract: Magnetic currents distribution problem in an antenna-waveguide structure, including double-slot diaphragm, a transmission-type cavity resonator, and radiation slot at an end of a semi-infinite rectangular waveguide is formulated and solved. Results of numerical and experimental investigations of such a system are presented.

articleTitle: High-Gain Mobile Satellite Antennas
abstract: This paper outlines the state-of-art of High-Gain Mobile Satellite Antennas (MSA) and describes their designs, benefits and specific impacts in Mobile Satellite Communications (MSC). In many respects the MSA infrastructures currently available for MSC constitute the weakest links of the system. If the mobile antenna has a high gain, it has to track the satellite, following both mobiles and satellite orbital motions. Namely, sometimes this is difficult and expensive to synchronize. Therefore, if the vehicular antenna has low gain, it does not need to perform tracking but the capacity of the communications link is limited. In general, according to the transmission direction, there are three types of MSA: 1) transmitting and receiving or so-called transceiving, as a part of all types of Mobile Earth Station (MES); 2) only receiving is part of the special Inmarsat EGC receiver and 3) only transmitting is built in satellite beacon antennas for maritime, land and aeronautical applications. On the other hand, all MSA are classified into omnidirectional and directional tracking antennas. The Inmarsat, Eutelsat, ESA, Cospas-Sarsat, Iridium, Globalstar, ICO, Orbcomm, ACeS, Thuraya, Insat and other GEO and Non-GEO current and forthcoming mobile satellite operators have conducted research on all network segments, including different types of MSA and their future development and improvements. The Engineering Test Satellite-V (ETS/V) experiments conducted in Japan for the transmission of voice, video and different data rate digital communications between ships, land vehicles and aircraft were successful. Moreover, a test of low-speed data transmission by using briefcase-size transportable equipment, onto which two small printed antennas were mounted, was among the experiments.

articleTitle: Influence of edge effects on radiation of resonant vibrator with square screen
abstract: Using the asymptotical solution of 3D vector problem of diffraction on perfectly conducting infinitely thin square screen the directional characteristics of field orthogonal components along the observation space are calculated. Influence of edge effects on width of the main lobe, gain and radiation resistance of a vibrator has been investigated at varying screen size L. It has been shown that for providing maximum gain the optimum screen size is L=1.2λ.

articleTitle: Q-band low-noise receiver module with protection on synchronous and nonsynchronous incident signals up to 1000 W impulse power
abstract: The design results of the solid-state Q-band low-noise receiver module with protection on synchronous and non-synchronous incident signals up to 1000 W impulse power are given. A bandwidth of the module is 6%, gain - 18 dB, noise factor - 4.6 dB, operating time - 0.2 μs.

articleTitle: Mapping the scientific heritage of professor B. L. Kashcheyev
abstract: This report presents a joint digital project of KHNURE departments for creation of a memorial archive dedicated to a scientist of worldwide reputation. Open-access electronic archives for scientists become increasingly important in the modern scientific communications. In memory of Prof. B. L. Kashcheyev and in honour of his 90<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> anniversary a project of the memorial archive electronic version was developed. This is the joint project of several university departments: the Scientific Library, the REF Department, STL «Radio Astronomy, Geophysics and Distance Sounding» and the University Museum. The most works of the scientist were published in 1960–1980s', but they are of vital importance for the modern science. Some of his papers were found in the Kharkiv libraries holdings, some of them are kept in the Museum of KhNURe.

articleTitle: Formation of complex image with active-passive radiomonitoring system
abstract: The image formation models in active and passive channels of radio monitoring systems in their simultaneous operation are considered. The image formation process was subsequently simulated through each of the channel and the acquired data were integrated to update the information content of acquired images.

articleTitle: Photocatalytic activity of structures of comprising mesoporous titania xerogel
abstract: A comparative analysis of photodegradation of tetracycline and the organic dye Rhodamine B in aqueous media in the presence of titania xerogel deposited on glass, aluminium foil and porous anodic alumina of 1.5, 3 N 150 μm thickness has been performed. The samples has revealed effective photocatalytic decomposition of tetracycline and the dye. The structures comprising porous anodic alumina 1.5 and 3 μm were found as the most effective.

articleTitle: The features of the optical monitoring of high-voltage cable networks
abstract: The technique of high-voltage cable networks monitoring by means of optical reflectometry is developed. Temperature dependence of the impulse level reflected from an abnormal site of a cable line is determined.

articleTitle: Voltage controlled limiter MMIC
abstract: A new circuit of voltage controlled limiter based on pin-diodes has been developed. It is experimentally shown that the leakage power level can be decreased up to 9 dBm.

articleTitle: Study of the combined effects of X-rays and low-energy microwave electromagnetic field on the state of chromatin in the nuclei of human buccal epithelium cells
abstract: Isolated human buccal epithelium cells of two men (22 and 25 years) and women (15 years) were irradiated with X-rays (200 and 800 μRh/h) for 1 minute, and microwaves (frequency - 36.6 GHz, the power density at the object level - 100 μW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) during 1 min. X-rays were used before and after microwave irradiation, with interval in 20 min. The number of granules of heterochromatin was determined after orcein staining immediately after irradiation. It was shown that the response of cells to radiation differs in some way for cells of different donors. Common features in the reaction of cells - the number of heterochromatin granules after irradiation at 200 μRh/h was significantly higher than after irradiation intensity of 800 μRh/h. Microwave irradiation before and after X-ray treatment virtually eliminates these differences.

articleTitle: Effect of microwave pump power on characteristics nonelectrode sulfuric lamps
abstract: An experimental setup to study the characteristics of nonelectrode sulfur lamp is created. An adjustable liquid-cooled attenuator is designed. The bulb temperature dependence vs. time at power of pumping is measured.

articleTitle: The Crimean period in the biography of prof. I. V. Brenev: (A brief essay commemorating the 110th anniversary of the birth of I. V. Brenev)
abstract: The life of Igor Vasilyevich Brenev, a well-known historian, Dr. of Technical Sciences, Professor, is closely tied with the Crimean and Sevastopol as well as with the Taurida University where he happened to spend his student days and finally with his service in the Black Sea Navy. These milestones in his research activity are outlined in the report compiled from a series of Crimean publications. The autograph left by I.V. Brenev in the Sevastopol Navel Library and the exhibition fragment are the first exhibits in the museum of Gymnasium No 3.

articleTitle: Statistical characteristics of measurement errors for phase incursion and frequency shift estimation for retransmitting meter signal
abstract: Probability density functions were derived for estimations of phase incursion and frequency shift that were realized by the method of rectangular waves and maximum a posteriori probability. It has been established that in the case when the anormal errors take place, the phase difference measurement accuracy decreases drastically, if the method of rectangular waves is in use, while the accuracy remains the same practically, if the maximum a posteriori probability method is applied.

articleTitle: Influence of the built-in peripheral electric field on current and voltage sensitivity of PT (photoelectric transducers) on the basis of metal-semiconductor contacts
abstract: It was shown that the built-in electric field, formed by contact periphery, influences greatly on the effectiveness of photoelectric transducers (PT) made on the basis of metal-semiconductor (M-S) contacts. Enhancement of this field results in increasing voltage sensitivity on >50% and current sensitivity on more than 50 times of these PT's. As a result a physical model of electric field distribution in M-S contacts was suggested, considering the built-in peripheral electric field, which accounts for increasing barrier conductivity under the influence of photoelectromotive force.

articleTitle: Ultra wide band impulse signals in future long range communication systems
abstract: Possibility and perspective of the use of IR - UWB signals in satellite and distant terrestrial radio systems have been examined and their parameters have been estimated.

articleTitle: Multiplication of frequency in gyrocon with longitudinal magnetic field
abstract: Optimum regimes are found and limiting parameters allowing twice-quadruple multiplication of frequency in a gyrotron with electronic efficiency more than 90% are adjusted.

articleTitle: Problems of development of intellectual systems
abstract: The problems connected to creation of intelligence systems are considered. There are problems of information representation, transformation of this information in the process of search of the solving a problem and the issue of uncertainty connected to ambiguity, an inaccuracy of the information definition. It is offered to consider the ontology approach based on usage of concepts and relations, relevant to a natural language, and the constructions constructed of them for formalization of process of the decision of tasks by intellectual system.

articleTitle: Tunable microwave filters based on coplanar lines
abstract: The electromechanical tune method for microwave filters based on coplanar lines are proposed. The simulation of the proposed filter structure was made by finite differences method in the time domain. This method allows tuning for resonance frequency about 80 percents with the air gap between the substrate and the signal electrode width about 50 μm. The proposed method can be realized with MEMS technology and piezoelectric actuators.

articleTitle: Uniform information environment of high school development
abstract: An approach for Common information environment (CIE) design for higher education institutions are proposed. The necessity of system creating is determined; prerequisites and tasks for information environment design are formed. Common information environment implementation produced on Microsoft SharePoint Server platform is considered.

articleTitle: Multiple frequency scattered fields' parametric plot analysis method for radioholographic objects' parameters estimation
abstract: The multiple frequency scattered field parametric plot analysis method is proposed and approved on a set of radioholographic test objects.

articleTitle: Possibility of satellite passive SAR
abstract: The possibility of passive synthesis of the satellite system antenna aperture for ground-based sources of illumination monitoring is discussed in the paper. There are given experimental data obtained by GPS, concerning inverse passive synthesis along the path Space-Earth. The data prove the possibility to build a passive SAR and the phase interference signal processing.

articleTitle: Preparation of electrodes for molecular transistor by focused ion beam
abstract: The blank-chips for molecular transistor were created using milling technology with focused ion beam technology (FIB). The optimal parameters for milling of metal electrodes were found, so it is possible to create a 30 nm gaps suitable for production of system with suspended electrodes. Electrical measurements of a gap show reliable cutting of a metal film. In situ production of simple nanostructures of various shapes potentially useful for quantum devices was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Threshold broadband spin-torque microwave detector
abstract: We propose a novel mode of operation of a spin-torque microwave detector (STMD), based on excitation of large-angle out-of-plane (OOP) magnetization precession. We analyze the performance of a STMD in this mode and show that detector operates as a non-resonant broadband threshold microwave detector in a wide range of low frequencies.

articleTitle: Model of the channel time-frequency synchronization
abstract: Principles of construction and structure of the channel model of time-and-frequency synchronization are considered. Parameters and features of application of model for a radio meteoric method of synchronization and the new method based on reception of signals of geostationary artificial satellites are resulted.

articleTitle: Breakdown pecularity of the shifted to source mesfet gate
abstract: Asymmetry of the gate-source and gate-drain current-voltage characteristics is connected with anomalous gate-source active layer punch through.

articleTitle: Efficiency of tunnel frame diodes generation allowing for electrons intervalley transfer in GaAs
abstract: The study is based on power and frequency-response characteristics of diodes, in which of certain voltages the NDC (negative differential conductance) occurs between ohmic connections due to electron tunneling through diode's side edges and due to intervalley transfer of electrons. The ability of generation and frequency multipication using such diodes in the MM-range is shown.

articleTitle: X-band printed antenna array with vertical polarization
abstract: The X-band printed phased-array antenna is designed with the following parameters: vertical polarization, vertical plane beam width is 22°, horizontal plane beam width is 9°, general sidelobes level is about ×16 dB, bandwidth is about 500 MHz. The antenna can be used as a sub-array for creation of more complex antenna, e.g. including 5 sub-arrays.

articleTitle: Influence of frequency of longitudinal oscillations of axial conductor on Q-factor of microwave biconical cavity
abstract: The effect of frequency of longitudinal oscillations of an axial conductor on Q-factor of a microwave biconical cavity has been experimentally investigated. These oscillations in the range 0-20 Hz do not substantially affect Q-factor.

articleTitle: Use of modified operating mode of gallium arsenid Gunn diodes in the 35–47 GHz millimetre-range generators
abstract: Impedance and operating temperature of Gunn diodes (GD) used in the modified mode (MM) are the same as in the transit-time mode. The MM may be realized in GD with the thin base layer (L<1.5μm), where the value of strong field domain equates, or exceeds, the base length. Extended frequency range and high efficiency of GD working in MM have allowed using GD efficiently in the following types of GD generators (GDG): GDG with output frequency F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>=35GHz (with tuning range 1GHz) with output power P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>>120mW, I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oper</inf>=0.5–0.55A and U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oper</inf>=4.5–5V; GDG with F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>=37GHz with P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>>140mW, I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oper</inf><0.7A and U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oper</inf><6V; and GDG with F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>=47GHz with P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>>100mW, I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oper</inf>=0.5–0.55А and U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oper</inf>=4.5–5V.

articleTitle: Spectral characteristics of the subharmonic mixer (SHM) of radio signals on the basis of the resonant-tunnelling diode
abstract: The results of the researches directed on improvement of quality's indicators of RED at the expense of using RTD in the mixer of radio signals are considered in the report. At an identical operating mode and size of conversion losses, power of the higher harmonics and combinational components in a spectrum of an output signal of the mixer on the basis of the resonant-tunneling diode (RTD) is lesser, than at the same mixer on Schottky diode.

articleTitle: A single fractionally rational measurement scale as the base of quantum theory of measuring conversion of phase-frequency and amplitude quantities
abstract: The principles of construction and theory of measuring conversion of physical quantities using a single fractional rational measurement scale. For the first time, the example of measuring the frequency of radio signals (with unknown time access to signals) have demonstrated the possibility of practical improvement both accuracy and speed measurements at 100–1000. The prospects of use: Methodology of the new theory can be used anywhere where you need to increase simultaneously the parameter PRECISIONxSPEED MEASUREMENT of physical quantities (military technology and medicine (imaging, rapid analysis, ultrasound), nanotechnology).

articleTitle: Automatization of evaluation of human function condition during the tasks of occupational selection
abstract: In this work methodological approach to evaluation of functional condition of a human and an automated complex for its realization are presented.

articleTitle: Research of SI for VHF-devices
abstract: Results of research of Si for VHF devices are submitted.

articleTitle: Tunable sandwich capacitors based on strontium titanate films
abstract: Tunable sandwich microwave capacitors based on strontium titanate (STO) thin films demonstrate tunability K = 2 under control voltage less than 30 V and Q-factor of 90 at 2 GHz and 40 at 8 GHz.

articleTitle: Practice of lot production of microwave blcks using the novel import metallized-support materials
abstract: The technology of manufacturing microwave electronic blocks using the state-of-the-art base materials. The advantages of utilizing case-shaped components in relation un-packaged ones. A comparison is made between the proposed technology and the conventional fabrication process.

articleTitle: Technology for construction of knowledge portals: Experience of application, problems and prospect
abstract: The paper concerns the experience of application of technology for construction of knowledge portals providing the systematization and integration of scientific knowledge and information resources, as well as the content-based access to them. The main feature of this technology is usage of ontology-based approach for these purposes.

articleTitle: Optical switching technologies in telecommunications
abstract: The article is dedicated to the micromirror optical commutators with the piezoelectric actuators, on which base it is possible to create All-Optical commutators for telecommunication systems. Various methods and assets for deflection and modulation of the optical signals have been shortly investigated. Some technical aspects of these types of devices were described.

articleTitle: The study of slot resonators for frequency selective microwawe waveguide structures
abstract: In this article we present results of numerical simulation of amplitude-frequency characteristics (AFC), phase-frequency characteristics (PFC) and group delay time (GDT) characteristics slot-structures place in rectangular waveguide with size 35×15 mm and frequency range 4-15 GHz. For numerical simulation we used CST-studio program.

articleTitle: An Open Civic Platform
abstract: The development of the Open Civic Platform is considered in the article. It includes a mobile application which is based on Android OS, a web application that is created using the Google Maps Javascript API and persistence data storage based on CouchDB. The platform provides a set of user-friendly tools to increase citizen's participation one the one side and to improve governance effectiveness on the other side.

articleTitle: Towards causal relation detection between activities in a software development scenario
abstract: On the Web, an increasing amount of information related to specific activities is scattered over various heterogeneous sources. In the domain of software development projects, where workflows are accompanied by different tools, it is becoming increasingly difficult to get an overview of the current situation, as decision and development processes are usually distributed among multiple sources. In this paper we present an approach for detecting causal relations between pieces of information scattered over different, heterogeneous sources.

articleTitle: Adaptive device for interfering television signals compensation
abstract: Effectiveness analysis of the adaptive method of interfering television signals compensation is carried out, taking into account its multipath propagation. The basic principles of implementation of the adaptive TV interference compensators prototype for receiving paths of secondary surveillance radars are presented, as well as results of its ground tests.

articleTitle: Enhancement of signals on the background of high-intensity noise via nonlinear transformations
abstract: The examples of using nonlinear transformations are considered when one has to do with of selecting a signal on the background of noise interference. A possibility to increase the initial value of the signal/noise ratio under the stochastic resonance is shown.

articleTitle: The pyramidal nanoantenna array
abstract: The paper concerns the pyramidal designs of nanoantennas array as a part of multilayered nanocircuits for realisation of wireless networks on the chip (WiNoC) on the basis of MIMO and MultiUser MIMO technologies.

articleTitle: Development antenna for standart mobile communication UMTS/WCDMA
abstract: Our reports presents the development of antennas for the third-generation mobile communication standard UMTS. This standard uses a frequency band of 1900-2100 MHz, so there is a communication problem with the uncertain reception in cities because of the built-up areas and an increase in the radio horizon in the open air. The issue of the development of antennas for operations in the network UMTS is considered in this report.

articleTitle: Test board for power FET's nonliner model extraction
abstract: The simple correction method is presented for the non-linear models of power FET's to be adjusted by means of measurements of transistors in a test board. The technique is based on measurement of the same transistor in 50 Ohm line and then in matching networks with known impedance realizing maximum gain factor at the operating point, and in a test circuitry adjusted for the maximum of output capacity.

articleTitle: Phased array of modified coaxial-sector radiators
abstract: Electrodynamic characteristics of the radiation phased arrays of modified coaxial-sector radiators of three types: "semicircular", circular "ridge" and "coaxial-ribbed" are investigated. Reflection coefficients and the partial pattern of the investigated arrays are calculated. The ellipticity values of an electromagnetic wave radiated by arrays are obtained.

articleTitle: Double-band circularly-polarized antenna for glonass/GPS applications
abstract: This paper presents a double-band stacked patch antenna intended for implementation in satellite navigation systems. The antenna consists of two radiating patches with a shared feed. Simulation and experimental results are described.

articleTitle: The analysis of amplitude non-linearity of autodyne oscillators stabilized by the external resonator
abstract: The analysis of the signal features of autodyne oscillators stabilized by the external high-Q resonator in the case, when the reflected signal amplitude is so large that the non-linearity of the active conductance of the resonance system influences on the formation of the autodyne response.

articleTitle: Simulator of Doppler frequency shift
abstract: The results of experimental research of imitator of Doppler effect in a waveguide with the use of modified double waveguide bridged-T network and varactor diode as a dynamic phase shifter guided by sawtooth voltage are presented.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave low-noise module of for a modulation radiometer
abstract: The paper presents the results of the development of low-noise modules operating in the millimeter wavelength range: electrical schematic diagram of a low-noise amplifier (LNA); methods and results of tests of the module's key parameters. At operating frequencies of 35.5 ÷ 37.5 GHz the module's gain was equal to 60.15 ± 0.45 dB to 56.15 ± 0.55 dB at the ambient temperature ranging from 10 ° C to 50 ° C respectively. The noise equivalent temperature of the module's input at operating frequencies was 369 ÷ 380 K.

articleTitle: Two-detector method of wave length determination in metaldielectric waveguide
abstract: The method of determination of a wave length in a metaldielectric waveguide, based on the analysis of results of signal measurement of power-level detectors, launched by traversal and longitudinal slots has been developed. The slots centres are located on known distance from the waveguide end, the phase shift between tapped off waves is 90° on any frequency of waveguide gamut, and signals from detectors are measured at consecutive connection of a matched load and the short-circuiter.

articleTitle: Detection zones of precipitation from the fluctuations pseudorange measurements to satellites system of global navigation
abstract: The possibility for detecting hazardous weather phenomena using data pseudorange measurement receivers of global satellite navigation systems GLONASS and GPS is considered.

articleTitle: Al thickness influence on optimal annealing temperature of Ta/Ti/Al/Mo/Au ohmic contacts to AlGaN/GaN
abstract: Process flow of Ta/Ti/Al/Mo/Au ohmic contacts formation to AlGaN/GaN heterostructures was developed. Correlation between Al thickness and optimal ohmic contact annealing temperature was obtained. Optimal Ta:Ti:Al:Mo:Au metal ratio was obtained for two different types of AlGaN/GaN heterostructures. Ohmic contacts fabricated in developed process flow show good surface morphology and contact resistance less than 0.5 Ohm/mm.

articleTitle: Researching of shielding characteristics of composites based on different sorbed components
abstract: Dependence of absorbing and reflecting ability of composite materials based on knitted fabric and different sorbents at the range of frequencies 8-12 GHz is investigated. Using of different sorption components in a material, it is possible to increase electromagnetic radiation up to 25 dB and reflecting ability up to ×12 dB. Practical recommendations on creation of shielding designs for protection of objects electromagnetic radiations are developed.

articleTitle: Simplified approach to simulation of crossed-field devices
abstract: The paper concerns the possibility to adapt systems describing the crossed-fields devices' operation in comparison with linearized ones. This simplification allows simplifying significantly the study of certain processes in such systems. It is shown that the error of this simplification does not exceed 9%. Using this approach we can estimate the frequencies of space-charge oscillations

articleTitle: Interoperability web application models based on microformats
abstract: The overview of popular microformats is carried out. The technology of microformats with implementation of semantic markup web pages and software applications is considered. The interoperability web application models are designed.

articleTitle: Research of influence of multiantenna technology MIMO on realisation of handover in cellular radioaccess systems
abstract: Research of influence by the multiantenna technology MIMO on realization of handover procedure in cellular radioaccess systems is carried out. By means of modeling possibilities, both improvements and deterioration of duration of handover procedure are shown with the use of MIMO in radiosystems.

articleTitle: The high-speed reflective waveguide ferrite phase shifter
abstract: The results of development and experimental research of Ka-band waveguide reflective Faraday phase shifter are presented. The latching phase shifter built on the non-metalized square ferrite rod is characterized by high speed and low power consumption. Optimization was carried out with the use of electrodynamic models based on finite element method.

articleTitle: Operation speed of ferrite devices for millimeter waves with longitudinal magnetization
abstract: The results of a number of developments of Ka-band ferrite devices working on the basis of Faraday effect are given. The characteristics of devices manufactured as per the classical model and based on the non-metallized ferrite rod are described. It shows a practical assessment of both structure types with minimum shifting time based on experience in a number of ferrite devices with longitudinal magnetization.

articleTitle: System for identifying and managing security vulnerabilities of billing systems
abstract: A billing system consists of many components that allow an end user to be able to add, view, print, or perform normal billing operations. These components can be in the form of servers, desktops, laptops, routers, firewalls, printers, and other appliances. All of these components connect together in some form to make up the complete billing system. The security of the whole billing system is reliant on the security of each individual component and process. Using a well managed and thorough vulnerability management system, the security of each of these components can be drastically increased.

articleTitle: The method of correction of digital television images recorded in bad weather
abstract: The method of correction of digital television images, recorded in bad weather, is presented. Adaptive histogram equalization was applied as the basis of the method.

articleTitle: Frequency dependance of electric characteristics of quantum devices
abstract: The electric characteristics of the devices based upon quantum wires are dependent upon the signal feed rate. The influence of frequency upon the conductivity and permittivity of electron gas is thoroughly studied. The specific frequency effects play an important role. They are attributed to the design features of quantum devices.

articleTitle: The method for calculating channel digital communication systems with a given probability of detection
abstract: The article describes an approximate method for calculating a channel of digital communication systems (DCS) with a given probability of detection. It is shown that for the calculations you need to use the experimental angular dependence of the fields created by custom adapters of wireless communication channels. A method of constructing two-dimensional detection zones of DCS using which you can determine its secrecy.

articleTitle: Calculation of nine section resonator for line collider
