abstract: The work concerns calculations of the accelerating section of the linear collider consisting of nine hollow resonators. The aim of the study is to determine the frequencies of adjacent modes to the main π mode cavity.

articleTitle: Multielement systems of coaxial-slot radiators
abstract: The problem of the excitation of a system transverse slots, cut in the outer conductor of the coaxial line was solved by the method of magnetomotive forces.

articleTitle: Auto-oscillation system based on dielectric resonator with “Whispering gallery” modes
abstract: The generation mechanism of microwave radiation in the system with azimuthally-periodical current of an electron beam that excites a high-Q quasi-optical dielectric resonator was developed. Eigen parameters of a cylindrical Teflon resonator were determined. Radiation was locked in the investigated system by a detector of 8-mm wave band. Design philosophy of microwave oscillators with high-Q resonators, in which electromagnetic “whispering gallery” modes are excited by electron beam, was developed.

articleTitle: The equivalent circuit and key relations for analysis of autodyne UHF oscillators stabilized by the external resonator
abstract: The functional and equivalent circuits of the autodyne oscillator stabilized by the external high-Q resonator are presented. The coupling between the operating and stabilized resonators is fulfilled constructively on the basis of the band-reflecting filter with the resistive coupling. The main mathematical equation describing the autodyne response of such a generator on the impact of the own reflected radiation are obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of plane spiral antennas using method of integral equation
abstract: Using numerical solution of modified Pocklington integral equation for a thin conductor with magnetodielectric coating, electrodynamic characteristics of a plane spiral antenna were investigated.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of stabilized UHF oscillator application in the autodyne radar
abstract: Results of the analysis of the application effectiveness of UHF oscillators in the autodyne radar stabilized by the external high-Q resonator are described. The advantages of this autodyne over the usual non-stabilized one-cavity autodyne oscillator.

articleTitle: Comparison of Si and GaAs schottky detectors
abstract: Comparative investigation of Si and GaAs microwave detector diodes has been carried out.

articleTitle: Interference nature of bands on dynamic spectra of solar radio bursts
abstract: On the basis of theory of electromagnetic wave radiation the formulas have been obtained for calculation of frequency of bands on dynamic spectra of solar radio emission. It has been found that the observed frequency of bands and intervals between them coincide with high exactness and the analytically calculated values. Numerical equality of frequencies is a validation of their interference origin related to the propagation of radio waves in plasma, but not with the mechanism of generation of radiation in the prime source of a burst.

articleTitle: The modulation method of measurement of the dipole reflection complex factor
abstract: The design principles of construction of a measuring instrument of reflection complex factor of a dipole on a modulation method basis are developed. The prototype of the transmitter is designed and built. The method for calibrating the meter and obtain relations for determining the parameters of the element under study and analysis of measurement errors.

articleTitle: To 75th anniversary of Viktor Vasilyevich Salamatin
abstract: A leading lecturer of Department of Radio Technology and Telecommunication of Sevastopol National Technical University, a renowned scientist in electrodynamics and radio-wave propagation, Viktor Vasilyevich Salamatin was born on August the 12th, 1936 in the Tambov region (Russia). 1943–1953 studied at secondary school, after school certificate he entered Novocherkassk Polytechnic Institute (graduated in 1958). He was directed to Experimental Design Bureau of the plant of electric-measuring instruments in Krasnodar. In 1958 — an engineer, 1959 — a senior engineer, 1966 — a chief engineer. 1966–1970 took an extramural postgraduate course at Kiev Polytechnic Institute (at present NTUU «KPI»). In 1970 he defended candidate dissertation, in 1971 on a competitive base was chosen as an assistant professor of Department of Theoretical basis of radio technology of Sevastopol Institute of Instrument Design, where he has been working up to the present day.

articleTitle: Marianna Ivanovna Poygina: To 50th anniversary of scientific and creative work
abstract: With honorable mediation of Marianna Ivanovna the short range coherent pulse radar of millimeter range for identification of mobile pin-point targets, oriented for defensive aids unit of station-keeping and moving objects, was engineered. Due to her initiative and creative participation of SRI «Orion» State program for Creation of Solid Element Base in Millimeter Range up to 300 GHz was successfully solved: on injection and transit effects in silicon and gallium arsenide; generators and amplifiers of pulse continuous operation on the basis of IMPATT diodes and Gunn-effect diodes, high-speed units for control of pulse height and signal phase, frequency converters, etc.

abstract: Professor Sergiy Sit'ko has discovered the nature of Life on the fundamental level and has shown that the Alive is the fourth (after nuclear, atomic and molecular) level of quantum organization of nature.

articleTitle: To 75th anniversary of professor Brzhezinskiy Vladislav Adamovich
abstract: From 1962 to 1964 — graduate student of physics department of Moscow State University. In 1965 defended a candidate thesis in physics and mathematics. From 1964 to 1972 occupied a position of a leading engineer and then a laboratory chief in a scientificresearch institute «Sapphire» of Ministry of Electronics Industry. From 1972 to 1987 worked as a senior research assistant and then as a laboratory chief in Scientific-Research Institute of Devices of Ministry of Secondary Machine Building. He was involved in the investigations of influence of ionization radiation on semiconductor devices and in 1982 he passed Ph.D thesis in Engineering.

articleTitle: To 70th anniversary of professor Manoylov Vyacheslav Philippovich
abstract: In 2011 it is 70 years to a well-known expert in the field of technical electrodynamics, antenna and microwave devices, medical equipment Vyacheslav Philippovich Manoylov.

articleTitle: The horizontally polarized X-band omnidirectional slot antenna
abstract: A pioneering prototype of antenna has been a slot antenna designed by Andrew Alford. That was the temporary array installed on the Chrysler Building for the CBS color television in 1946. This type of antenna can be used to develop marine Search and Rescue Radar Transponders and Radar Target Enhancers of the X-band navigation part. The basic antenna parameters are as follows: horizontal polarization, vertical plane beamwidth of±20°, omnidirectional in azimuth with an irregularity variation is ±1dB, gain variation in the frequency band of 9.2-9.5 GHz is less than 0.2 dB, general side lobes level is close to -18 dB.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of application of double-cavity oscillators in the autodyne short-range radar
abstract: The review of the double-cavity oscillator application in autodyne short-range radar is offered. Recommendations on UHF oscillator application in the system consisting the stabilized by external high-Q resonator mode in the autodyne radar of different implementation with both continuous radiation and with different types of modulation are described.

articleTitle: C-and X-band switch MMIC's based on heterostructure pin-diodes
abstract: This paper presents the results of development of C-and X-band switch MMIC's based on heterostructure pin-diodes. The circuits are characterized by the low insertion loss and good insulation in the working frequency band.

articleTitle: The role of fatty acids in realization of anti-tumor effects of extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation
abstract: It was shown for the first time that the exposure of tumor-bearing mice to extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation (EHF EMR) with effective parameters (frequency of 42.2 GHz, intensity of 0.1 mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, exposure duration for 20 min daily during 5 consecutive days after inoculation of Ehrlich carcinoma) restores the composition of fatty acids (FA's) in thymic cells, modified by the tumor growth, to a condition which is typical for intact animals. The EHF EMR exposure also decreased the content of monounsaturated FA's (MUFA's) and increased the content of polyunsaturated FA's (PUFA's) in the tumor node.

articleTitle: Prospects of designing radiation-hard memory devices, made by OJSC “Integral”
abstract: The characteristics are indicated of radiation-hard memory devices, made by OJSC “Integral” with consideration of the status and prospects of the news designs of the memory microcircuits.

articleTitle: Determination of aeroionic air composition parameters
abstract: The results from estimating the background values of light air ions concentration (STP) at normal environmental conditions and the findings of experimental studies on the variation in light-ion concentrations are given below.

articleTitle: Use of self-aligned technology in GaAs diode fabrication
abstract: The technology of quasi-vertical diodes which allows improving diode parameters is developed. The main feature of this technology is use of self-aligned principle in diode base and ohmic contact production. The results of experiment show that self-aligned technology has advantages in fabrication and improves diode's series resistance, reverse leakage current and ideality factor.

articleTitle: Unified access interface to heterogeneous databases
abstract: The ontology-based approach for relational databases integration is proposed. Mapping of the relational schemas into one ontology and further translation of SPARQL-queries into SQL-queries are fundamental point of approach. The result provides a unified access interface in the form of SPARQL-end point.

articleTitle: 4G telecommunication services providing to rail express passengers
abstract: The report presents the conceptual foundations of the mobile communication network construction providing up to 2000 subscribers with 4G mobile terminals (MT) movement up to 500 km/hr. In addition, the results of partial calculations confirm the feasibility of the network being considered.

articleTitle: Natural frequency and Q-factor estimation for open resonators with strong coupling
abstract: It has been shown that the position of a minimum of the frequency dependence of the reflection coefficient for a half-disk resonator does not always coincide with the natural frequency. This result has been obtained by means of numerical simulation for the resonator on the metal mirror with various sizes of the aperture of a coupling element for the mode of whispering gallery. More correct results have been obtained by means of fractional-rational approximation.

articleTitle: Applying business process modeling method when telecommunication services development
abstract: The process of telecommunication services development and its problems are considered. Suggested method of business process (BP) modeling is described. Its application to telecommunication services (TCS) development is suggested. Suggested service provisioning business processes (SP BP) models are described.

articleTitle: Optimal reconfigurable base stations (R-BS) architecture and requirements to R-BS
abstract: The problems associated with defining the requirements for base stations, which will operate being based on SDR-technology are considered. Based on these requirements, new SDR-Base Station architecture, which allows reconfiguration radio access network, is proposed.

articleTitle: Adaptive method of interfering television signals compensation
abstract: The efficiency comparative analysis of compensation methods for interfering signals suppressing in its multi-path propagation is performed. The method of adaptive compensation of TV signals interference in the reception path of a secondary surveillance radar is proposed. Theoretical basis of the method is presented, taking into account the multipath propagation of interfering TV signals.

articleTitle: Formation of target range unambiguity sign in radar with television illumination
abstract: Numerous studies in the field of bistatic radars with television illumination confirmed the potential for use of television signal for radar target detection. However, high TV lines correlation defines the target range detection ambiguity. To overcome this ambiguity the algorithm of formation of target range unambiguity sign is proposed.

articleTitle: Nanodimensional heterostructures, from experiment to theory
abstract: The barrier structure acting as a nanodimensional-aperiodic film built upon an ordered crystalline basis has been synthesized. It is suggested that volt-ampere characteristics should be determined in terms of describing a defective structure. This description is based on an energy-stoichiometric image of a disordered material.

articleTitle: Spatial filtering of adaptive antenna array signals under conditions of noise arrival from random directions
abstract: The aim of the given work is to develop and investigate the method for spatial filtering of the adaptive antenna array (AAA) signals by the criterion of maximum signal-to-noise relation at the antenna input with the noise arriving from random directions.

articleTitle: Simulating of double-channel heterotransistor with rectangular quantum wells and quantum dots
abstract: Simulation results of two-channel four-barrier heterotransistors (HEMT) with quantum dots (QD) are shown. As a result, distributions of velocity, concentration and potential energy surface were obtained.

articleTitle: Designing of multimesa impatt diodes MM wave band with minimum parasitic parameters of active structure
abstract: The design-oriented technological analysis of the most effective ways of producing multimesa impatt diodes 5 and 3 mm in diameter wave for the continuous operation is carried out. The factors that limit the possibilities of further growth in output power and efficiency are defined. The variant of mul-timesa impatt diodes with a large number of the mesastructures is defined under the minimum influence of parasitic parameters.

articleTitle: The experimental simulation of the spatial waves in multicoupled quasi-optical systems
abstract: The experimental equipment and the general method of modeling of electromagnetic wave processes in multicoupled quasi-optical systems are described. Examples of choosing the optimum modes of modeling and basic parameters of the investigated electrodynamic systems are shown. The functional diagram of the experimental plant is also described. The general method of modeling of electromagnetic phenomena in resonant and wave-guide multicoupled quasi-optical systems is presented for the first time.

articleTitle: To question about concordance in antenna fider highway of the earthly satellite stations
abstract: Presented the results of researches of concordance in the antenna fider highways of the earthly satellite stations and analysis of real developments.

articleTitle: 5-Mm band communication system's components
abstract: The design principles and technology of fabrication of key elements of 5-mm band communication systems are developed. 5-mm band LNA, power amplifiers, mixers and synthesizers are developed and produced. The noise figure of LNA is 4 dB, saturated power of power amplifier is 100 mW, the phase noise of LO signal is -95 dBc/Hz @ 10 kHz.

articleTitle: Research of influence of supply mode of double-drift avalanche diodes on Q-factor of 3-mm band noise oscillator
abstract: The experimental research of silicon double-drift avalanche diodes which are the active element of 3-mm super wideband noise oscillators that work in the anomalous mode, was held. The influence of the supply mode of diodes on quality coefficient of the noise oscillator (NO) was shown.

articleTitle: Formalized model of the zone presence of biological objects structures
abstract: A new approach investigating and diagnosing the current conditions of the biological organism is proposed. A hypothesis about the possible conception of a new approach to detection of biological structure conditions of living organism using the methods, which are nondestructive for this physical and field's structure. This conception of research on the spatio-temporal characteristic of biological structures and this spectr a may be indicative of condition processes in the whole organism under the impact of external and internal factors.

articleTitle: Influence of drain-to-source channel linear measurements of the gallium arsenide MEFSET on its static volt-ampere characteristics (effect of lateral dimensions)
abstract: The lateral dimension effect of GaAs channel epitaxial layers of drain-to-source (D-S) MEFSET appears depending on resistivity ρ(l, d) of its linear dimensions: length l and width d. Depending on the manufacturing technology for the specified length l, every material is characterized with its optimal width of d channel, when a minimum carrier scattering is observed, which influences greatly on MEFSET instrument characteristics: increasing of noise ratio. Considering the used epitaxial GaAs structures, the maximum drain current at minimum electron scattering is achieved for l=5 microns at d=100 microns. In case when l><5 microns, it causes the appearance of negative differential resistance regions in D-S VAC, and when d>150 microns D-S VAC become saturated.

articleTitle: Growing and surface treatment of BiSb single crystals
abstract: This paper offers a description of single crystal growing for bismuth-antimony alloys using the technology of floating-zone refining, with surface etches compounds being detailed.

articleTitle: Public component design technology of semantic compatible computer systems with different level of intelligence
abstract: The principles of construction technology of designing intelligent systems which are oriented to semantic representation of knowledge, expansion of the number of developers and shortening time of design are considered.

articleTitle: The quality factors' estimation in generated crossed field system
abstract: The problem of estimating the quality factors of generated crossed-field systems is described. The problem of determining the most significant factors affecting the output spectrum is stated. To gain a better insight into spectral components an interaction between the components of the cross-field system is schematically presented. Referring to the analysis below, it appears that a detailed study on each structure component is needed and in terms of the foregoing, the quality parameters of these systems have to be specified.

articleTitle: Application of ontologies in tools for development of intelligent decision support systems
abstract: The tools for development of intelligent decision support systems (IDSS) are described. The role of ontologies in the tools and IDSS designed on basis of it is discussed.

articleTitle: Procedure of selection of parameters of MIMO systems with intercell interference
abstract: The task of buildup of frequency efficiency in cellular communication networks in process of transmission of signals through multibeam channels is considered. The procedure of selection of parameters of MIMO-system has been proposed. Given technique considerably increases the capacity of the system under the condition of intercell interference.

articleTitle: Eigenmodes of dielectric sphere shielded by one-dimensional photonic crystal
abstract: The investigation results of eigenmodes of dielectric sphere obtected by multilayer dielectrical periodical structure are presented. General regularities of distribution of quality factor of different types of oscillations have been determined.

articleTitle: Improving efficiency service of queue in nodal centers
abstract: A method is proposed for calculating the carrying capacity, which can rotate from a queue with high-priority traffic to a queue with low-priority traffic, to improve the efficiency of data transfer, to reduce the level of packet lost, associated with time out expectations in the queue of on-line applications.

articleTitle: Soft decision decoding of the matroid codes
abstract: Matroid or M-codes are a class of non-binary linear block codes that are represented by matrices generated by a cycloclass over Galois field extension. A soft-decision (SD) of M-decoding based on combination of the modified Chase iterative algorithm and the generalized minimum distance decoding controlled by the symbol reliability is proposed and investigated. The contribution of this work is that experimentally is confirmed theoretical assumptions about gain increase due to SD application. An improvement of 1,5 dB of SD vs. hard-decision M-decoding is obtained. Results of the M-decoding simulation are presented and analyzed.

articleTitle: The contribution of Kyiv research institute of microdevices to the radioelectronics development in ukrainian (the 1960s of the 20-th century)
abstract: The present paper is devoted to the establishment and activity of the Kyiv research institute of microdevices. Specifically, an emphasis is placed upon investigating and describing the characteristic features of the Institute's activity. Based upon the results obtained from the studies and development efforts, one can highlight the significance of the Institute's advances in the evolution of radioelectronics beginning from the second half of the 60s of the XX-th century.

articleTitle: Immittance logic for signal procesors
abstract: The design principles for construction of immittance logic circuits were developed for digital signal processors.

articleTitle: The Monte Carlo calculation of current-voltage characteristics of short-channel Si-MOSFET
abstract: The current-voltage characteristics of Si-MOSFET with channel length of 50 nm are calculated by the many-particle Monte Carlo method. An influence of electron scattering by ionized impurity and plasmons on the characteristics is studied.

articleTitle: Even algorithm for excitation equations of E0j-modes in irregular waweguides with circular section
abstract: The system of excitation equations of E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0j</inf> — modes in the irregular waveguide with circular section is formulated in the even form (the first derivatives of amplitudes of E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0j</inf> — modes in the core of the system are absent). This form of equations allows using of effective and convergence even algorithms for solutions. The effectiveness of suggested method is corroborated at series of examples of problem solutions for irregular waveguides with intense remarkable profiles.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable antenna structural synthesis problem peculiarities
abstract: A reconfigurable antenna (RA) mathematical modeling problem is examined in consideration of reconfigurable antenna structural synthesis problem peculiarities in case when the radiating system contains both discrete and continuous control elements.

articleTitle: Influence of microwave treatment on incubation of hardroe of carp
abstract: The results of exploratory researches of microwave stimulation on reproductive products of carp - fish roe which is fertilized by milt roe - are given.

articleTitle: Radiator of a surface electromagnetic wave with ribbed anisotropic slow-wave structure
abstract: Mathematical simulation was used to determine the directional diagram of a surface wave radiator on the basis of the ribbed slow-wave structure with a variable delay factor.

articleTitle: Results of experimental investigations of autodyne UHF oscillators stabilized by the external resonator
abstract: The description of the experimental setup is given for investigation of the autodyne UHF oscillators implemented using the module NI-9205 of company National Instruments consisting of the platform DAQ-9172, providing the connection via USB interface with PC for signal processing with the help of the virtual instrument created in LabView 8.6. Results of the experimental investigations of the oscillating module of 8mm-range "Tigel-08" manufactured on the hybrid-integrated technology on the basis of the two-mesa Gunn diode stabilized by the reflection from the external high-Q resonator are discussed.

articleTitle: Synchronization of the antenna-oscillators with external microwave irradiation
abstract: Power combining in the array of microwave oscillators, consisted of log-periodical antennas with field-effect transistors as active elements, is experimentally studied. The opportunity for considerable improvement of the oscillation efficiency due to the mutual synchronization is shown and conditions of the radiation pattern formation are defined.

articleTitle: Switching current regulator with protection of the IMPATT diode from burnout
abstract: In this paper we propose a current regulator for an IMPATT oscillator with protection of the IMPATT diode from a load throw-off. The IMPATT oscillator operates in the 5-mm wave band. Its output power is greater than 50mW. The circuit for measuring the output resistance of the current regulator versus frequency has been developed. The current regulator provides current of 70-120mA across the load; switch on time is less than 0.1μs, output resistance is 2.45kΩ at 1 MHz.

articleTitle: The technique of pulse signals processing in a phase plane
abstract: The procedure of processing of pulse diagnostics on the basis of representation of cardiac beats in a phase plane, principles of a phase portrait build-up by means of orthogonal transformations is considered.

articleTitle: Signal frequency meter for 5kHz–12GHz range
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of further development of the meter of FMD-012 and FMD-012H [1] continuous harmonic signal frequency described in [2].

articleTitle: Wind measurements at 80–105 km altitude by television broadcasting signals reflected from meteor trails
abstract: The possibility of using terrestrial television (TV) broadcast signals (TVBS) as sounding signals for mesosphere-lower thermosphere (MLT, 80-105 km) wind measurements by the radio meteor method is investigated. Results of experimental observations show for the first time that TVBS can be used for MLT wind measurements and that the developed technique may be used for MLT wind monitoring on the base of the existing terrestrial TV broadcasting network.

articleTitle: Resonance degenerate cubic crystal made of spheres located in a magnetodielectric medium
abstract: The solution and analysis of a problem concerning plane wave scattering by a resonance degenerate cubic crystal, made of spheres located in a magnetodielectric medium, are considered.

articleTitle: System of collective construction of ontology with extended language of representation
abstract: The paper describes the concept of implementing of a system EZOP for the collaborative construction of ontologies. The main problem in the formalization of knowledge of groups of researchers in the form of ontologies is the need to study the language of representation of ontology. One of the most significant features of the system described in this report is the ability to extend the language by which users interact with the system. The approach described in the report allows experts to create own knowledge of language of representation that reflects their knowledge.

articleTitle: Calculation of high speed switchable waveguide ferrit Y-circulator
abstract: The results of investigation of high speed switchable ferrite Y-circulator with internal inverse flow are presented. Calculations are carried out with the use of electrodynamic models based on finite element method confirming the feasibility of the device in the Ka-band frequencies with low loss, high isolation and good matching in the 5% frequency band.

articleTitle: Characteristics of mesh polarizers for EH and THz frequencies made of film structures
abstract: We present the properties of mesh polarizers based on the foiled polyimide films and thin metallic slides for EH (Extremely High) and THz frequency ranges, which have excellent specifications. Typical values of transmission of the mesh polarizers in the directions perpendicular and parallel to the electric field vector were -30 dB and -0.2...0.3 dB, respectively, for the width of the wires equal to 18 microns and a pitch of the mesh equal to 50 microns. The developed technology may also be used for making such quasi-optical components as band-pass, high-pass, low-pass filters, etc., for EH and THz frequency ranges.

articleTitle: Stroboscopic selection of broadband RF signals with coherent probing
abstract: Stroboscopic transformation of periodic RF radar signals in close-range location problems is inspected. It is shown that using coherent radar signals combined with stroboscopic processing allows combining high distance resolution and Doppler frequency selection.

articleTitle: Tuner «Laspi-Stereo»: From consumer goods to cultural legacy
abstract: The design principles of converting the tuner “Laspi-001-Stereo” from an object of household consumption to cultural legacy are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of resonant excitation of electromechanical vibrations in carbon nanotube radio receiver
abstract: The results of finite element method (FEM) simulation of resonant excitation of the vibrations of carbon nanotubes (CNT) and their bundles by microwave electromagnetic fields due to ponderomotive forces are presented and discussed from the viewpoint of nanoradio design.

articleTitle: Resistive switching in hafnium dioxide at thermal phase transition
abstract: The results of simulation of reversible thermal breakdown of conductive filaments (nanowires) in hafnium dioxide in metal/HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/metal(silicon) (MIM(S)) at phase transition in HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are presented. We show that the current voltage characteristics of nanowires are characterized by 3 phases, where 2 of them are linear, and the middle one has the S-shaped form.

articleTitle: Calculation of bit error rate in system, based on DWDM technology
abstract: The results of the research, which are represented in this article, show the method of estimation of a probability of an error in DWDM systems, which might be utilized in the process of planning or modernization of already existent optical network. And also, the analytical model is resulted for estimation of losses from the effect of FWM.

articleTitle: Control of limiting currents of two charged-particle beams in coaxial drift tube
abstract: The dependence of limiting currents of two concentric magnetically-confined annular charged-particle beams on non-zero bias voltage applied to the inner conductor of a coaxial drift tube is studied. We show that the control over the limiting currents on the level up to 15 per cent for electron beams can be achieved with the inner conductor bias voltage not greater than 50 kV.

articleTitle: Autodyne parameters and characteristics of UHF oscillators stabilized by the external resonator
abstract: The equations for determination of coefficients of auto-detecting, autodyne amplification and the frequency deviation are obtained. Characteristics of auto-detection, phase, amplitude and frequency characteristics of the auto-dyne oscillator stabilized by the external high-Q resonator under impact of the own reflecting signal are found. Calculations and analysis of the mentioned parameters and characteristics describing the peculiarities of signal formation of autodyne oscillators are fulfilled.

articleTitle: The influence of electrical characteristics of microwave magnetron power source on the process of plasma stripping from silicon plates surface
abstract: The results of experimental research of the dependence of the rate of photoresist films ashing from the surface of silicon plates by microwave discharge plasma of air and О<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> vs. operational processing modes are presented. Plasma chemical processing had been carried out in a resonator-type plasmatron with partial filling by plasma (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">plasma</inf> ≥ 9500 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) of the resonant cavity volume. Experiments were carried out using, as a part of a high voltage power source, the microwave magnetron of the schemes of one-or two-half-period straightening with doubling voltage.

articleTitle: Broadband GaAs MMIC mixer
abstract: Results of designing the GaAs MMIC mixer with dimensions 1.5×1.2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> have been presented. The IC provides conversion loss 8.2–10 dB and image-reject at level 30 dB within 3–7 GHz frequency range.

articleTitle: Measurement of rain intensity profile by means of double frequency radar
abstract: The double frequency method for rain intensity profile measurement is proposed, which provides single-valued measurement of rain profile with high accuracy, taking into account the path attenuation.

articleTitle: A pulsed method for measuring minor changes both in the q-factor and in resonant frequency of microwave resonators
abstract: A method is suggested for measuring the resonant frequency shift and changes in the quality factor of resonant transducers in terms of the Fourier-components analysis of a pulsed microwave signal.

articleTitle: Monitoring of land underflooding by aviation remote sensing complex ACRS-30
abstract: In the paper theoretical approaches and results of Integrated monitoring of land underflooding by a side-looking Ka-band radar, an aerial camera and IR scanner of aviation complex of remote sensing ACRS-30 are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of complex additive on structure and IR properties of porous anodic alumina
abstract: The IR properties, mesoporous and crystalline structures, and phase composition of anodic alumina films formed in aqueous solutions of malonic acid with the additives of arsenazo I and without have been studied.

articleTitle: UWN project: Rapid linguistic applications development platform
abstract: A technological platform that enables collaboration of ontological bases and linguistic logic has been created in UWN project. A number of linguistics modules with ontology functions and a set of software packages with server-side logic based on the platform were created.

articleTitle: Calculation of MANET subscibers connectivity time
abstract: The paper presents two mathematical models for calculation of the connectivity time of the MANET nodes according to their mobility in the case of direct radio visibility and in the case of two-hop relay.

articleTitle: Officer, historian of radio communication Yevgeny antoninovich Fedotov (to 85th birthday)
abstract: Updated information about a prominent Sevas-topolian historian of nascent stage of radio communication, the main initiator of construction of a monument in commemoration of 100-th anniversary of invention of radio service, a pioneer of advancement of a discipline “History of development of radio technologies and telecommunications” in terms of a conference CriMoCo, a member of Program Committee, Yevgeny Antoni-novich Fedotov (1926-2009) - about his professional activities as an officer, the last two day of his life and his demise.

articleTitle: Development of highly dynamic pass-band filters (PBF)based on magnetostatic waves (MSW) with high out-of-stopband level
abstract: The results of development of pass-band filters (PBF) based on magnetostatic waves (MSW) in the frequency range of 1.0...18.0 GHz with the out-of-stop band level of 80 dB are presented. The study includes the dependence of the filter parameters (minimal losses in the pass band, the out-of-stop band, etc.) on the distance between the receiving and transmitting antennas of coplanar converters, the frequency operating range, magnetization intensity (4Πμs) of the ferrite waveguide structures of the yttrium iron garnet (YIG), and the the geometric dimensions of coplanar converters. The possibility to increase intensity of one-decibel compression to 30 dBmW for PBF based on surface MSW (SMSW) is indicated. The PBFs with the out-of-stop band level of 80 dB with both electric and mechanical adjustment of the amplitude frequency characteristic (AFC) are developed.

articleTitle: Radio frequency test method for wireless communications using Volterra model
abstract: Choice of a method of identification is one of the main factors on which reception of adequate communication channel model depends. Identification methods of nonlinear dynamical objects using Volterra kernels based on pulse responses are studied. The efficiency of reviewed methods, algorithms and developed software is shown using computer modeling.

articleTitle: Polarization properties of corner reflectors with metallized facets
abstract: Polarization properties of kaleidoscopic type non-cubic corner reflectors with metallized facets are investigated. Linearly polarized wave bunch reflection cases are examined.

articleTitle: Adaptation of university fixed telephony to IP technologies
abstract: Variants of transition of fixed telephony of Sevastopol National Technical University to IP technologies are considered. New tariff plan of the provider is proposed. The main advantages of transition to SIP protocol are defined. The cost effectiveness of upgrading of the existing university telephone network is estimated.

articleTitle: Physical substantiation of using the variations in the conductivity of water to estimate the microwave of electromagnetic radiations intensity
abstract: The impact of low-intensity electromagnetic radiation on water has been analyzed, and the results of this examination are presented. A possibility to evaluate the electromagnetic radiated power that affects the water indicating gage depending upon its conductivity is revealed.

articleTitle: Direction-finding accuracy of the linear digital array under jitter conditions
abstract: The direction-finding method for a linear digital array is synthesized. The approximate expression of estimation variance is obtained. The results of computational modeling are presented.

articleTitle: About magazine «Multiservise Cable Television Networks» (to 10-th anniversary of first issue)
abstract: In 2001–2003 in the Crimea a research-to-practice magazine «Multiservise Cable Television Networks» was published (only 5 issues were printed). Information background, objects, format and content of the edition as well as the main reasons of suppression were observed in the report of a head editor of the magazine.

articleTitle: Investigation into mechanisms of scattering in plasma waves heterostructures
abstract: Based upon the method of statistical modeling, the study on the key mechanisms of wave scattering in semiconductor heterostructures, has been carried out. Besides, the basic characteristics of the physical process involving the charge carrier transfer under the condition of plasma waves occurrence have been likewise examined. The novel feature about these processes is the application of the statistical modelling and the self-consistent solution of equations of the hydrodynamic model. This allowed one to reveal the basic physical mechanisms behind an increasing velocity of plasma wave propagation and to lay down the requirements for selecting the heterostructure electro-physical parameters to produce THz — range oscillations.

articleTitle: Slow-wave PBG structures for terahertz electronics
abstract: Dispersion characteristics of the 2D photonic crystal with vacuum corrugated waveguide introduced are investigated. Slow-wave modes of the photonic crystal waveguide are obtained for different phase velocities. These modes are suitable for synchronization with non-relativistic electron beam.

articleTitle: Analysis of dispersion characteristics of E0i-waves circular corrugated waveguide
abstract: Currently, a number of research-oriented centers in Russia, Ukraine, United States, Great Britain, France, China are engaged in conducting in-depth studies in the field of developing high-power microwave sources for relativistic electron beams TWT, BWO, gyrotron, free-electron lasers, and others

articleTitle: Numerically-analytical method of the diffraction problems solution of a H-wave on the slot in a thick waveguide wall
abstract: The algorithm of the numerically-analytical solution of a diffraction problem of the H-wave on the slot in a plane-parallel waveguide is developed and its efficiency in a wide range of a problem parameters' change is shown.

articleTitle: Array Mobile Satellite Antennas
abstract: This paper outlines the state-of-art of Array Mobile Satellite Antennas (MSA) and describes their designs, benefits and specific impacts in Mobile Satellite Communications (MSC). In many respects the MSA infrastructures currently available for MSC constitute the weakest links of the system. If the mobile antenna has a high gain, it has to track the satellite, following both mobiles and satellite orbital motions. Namely, sometimes this is difficult and expensive to synchronize. Therefore, if the vehicular antenna has low gain, it does not need to perform tracking but the capacity of the communications link is limited. The MSA can send signals via transmitter (Tx) and receive via receiver (Rx) in the same time, or can be Tx or Rx only. On the other hand, all MSA are classified into omnidirectional and directional tracking antennas. All MSC GEO and Non-GEO current and forthcoming operators have conducted research on all network segments, including different types of MSA and their future development and improvements. The type of MSA in general and the array antennas for MSA applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Printed antennae of millimeter range with circular and linear polarization
abstract: The article describes plane printed antennas of different polarization of radiated waves. Also combined receive-transmit antennas with different wave polarization are considered. The methods of feeding and matching are used. The practical three examples intended for 34 GHz frequency range are given. The results of models of computer simulation are compared with experimental data.

articleTitle: LTCC based planar modules for X-band aesa
abstract: It is shown that it is possible to develop LTCC based multichannel integrated planar receiver modules (clusters) for any size X-band AESA. For this purpose LTCC based planar submodules with an integrated patch antenna was developed. It is a clearly seen that LTCC technology helps to make cheap, small, lightweight and ruggedized planar and conformal AESA.

articleTitle: Measurement of microwave electromagnetic radiations of nonthermal intensity
abstract: A method for measuring the power of millimeter and submillimeter (wave) low-intensity electromagnetic radiations is proposed. This method is based on the effect of radiation-impacted variation in the electrical conduction in water.

articleTitle: Adaptation of sonars to nouse conditions
abstract: The method of frequency interference adaptation of sonars for the atmosphere remote sensing is worked out. The algorithm envisages the analysis of a frequency band, choice of channels with a minimum interference level and corresponding frequency change of a sonar. This allows increasing essentially a real sensitivity of sonars, the range of the sonar and the accuracy of measurement of meteorological parameters.

articleTitle: Toward the matrix polarimetry method of thin film coatings
abstract: The results obtained from studying the impact of optical-geometrical parameters of thin-layered models containing the particles of different shapes and sizes as well as the degree of orient ability toward their light scattering matrices how been analyzed. A special emphasis is placed upon the peculiar aspects of the matrix polarimetry method and it is in fact expedient to use this technique in implementing and developing the non-destructive methods to control thin film coatings.

articleTitle: Electroconductive properties of nanodimensional CoSbx(30 nm)/SiO2(100 nm)/Si(001) film compositions — Functional elements of thermoelectrics
abstract: This paper is devoted to the study of the effect of deposition conditions and heat treatment on the structure and the phase composition and electroconductive properties of nanodimensional CoSb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>(30 nm)/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(100 nm)/Si(001) (where x = 3; 3.5) film compositions (NFC's). The resistance dependence on temperature of NFC's under investigation depends on the phase composition of a film and has a semiconductor character.

articleTitle: The usage of knowledge base in probability-algebraic simulation of mechanical systems reliability
abstract: An approach to studying the reliability of mechanical systems is proposed. It rests upon the use of probability-algebraic simulation and the knowledge base, which is meant to correct the process of simulation and its parameters and constitutes the inteltctual system for decision-making support.

articleTitle: Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) applicable for mobile satellite communications
abstract: This paper describes in particular Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) applicable in Mobile Satellite Communications (MSC). In satellite communication systems, as a rule, especially in MSC many users are active at the same time. The problem of simultaneous communications between many single or multipoint mobile users, however, can be solved by using Multiple Access (MA) technique. Since the resources of the systems such as the transmitting power and the bandwidth of Radio Frequencies (RF) are limited, it is advisable to use the channels with complete charge and to create a different MA to the channel. This generates a problem of summation and separation of signals in the transmission and reception parts, respectively is discussed. Deciding this problem consists in the development of orthogonal channels of transmission in order to divide signals from various users unambiguously on the reception part.

articleTitle: Chronology of electroncs history
abstract: There is given the chronology of events connected with electronics birth and development as the bases for understanding the history of technique's lessons.

articleTitle: Dielectric spectroscopy at microwaves
abstract: The method of dielectric spectroscopy is described. The method is used to study micro - and macroscopic mechanisms of polarization, nature of phase transitions in materials of different aggregate states. Methods for dielectric parameters measurement at microwaves are classified.

articleTitle: Edwards curves are in perspective cryptosystems
abstract: The comparative estimation of calculable complication of procedures of generation of elliptic curves is presented. The new class of cryptosystems, which different from the existing dynamic change parameters of elliptic curve in the processes of encipherment, generation of PRS and other cryptotransformations, is presented.

articleTitle: Software for microwave office that integrates real and virtual measuring means based on uniform measurement methods and interface
abstract: The measurement control software that provides the uniform methods and interface with virtual measurements is considered. This uniformity allows considering the hardware and virtual instrumentation as a single tool for diagnosing the quality of nonlinear models of the elements at UWB and pulse impacts.

articleTitle: Methodology for the complex MDE-model of software development
abstract: A new approach to creation of a complex software model is presented, it uses application's distinction to business logic and interface, both described by XML. Syntax offered for describing application's algorithm similar to common programming languages. FaceXML [1] is used to describe user interfaces. Tools for WYSIWYG design of the algorithm and interface as well as interpreter, which executes a resulting model, are developed.

articleTitle: Possibilities of the antenna polarimetry of the mobile measuring complex
abstract: Results of the analysis of potential possibilities of an antenna polarimetry of electromagnetic radiations on the microwave oven of a mobile measuring complex are resulted.

articleTitle: Scientist, teacher, inventor
abstract: The 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> of June, 2011 is the eightieth birthday of the well-known expert in the field of creation of adaptive electric devices and sensor systems for control parameters of technological processes and environment, Dr. Sci. Tech., Professor Yuriy Alekseyevich Skripnik. Mr. Skripnik was born in 1931 in Lugansk. In 1948 he graduated a secondary school with a gold medal and entered Kiev Polytechnic Institute. In 1957 he started his postgraduate study in Kiev Polytechnic Institute. In 1961 at the Moscow Power Engineering Institute he was appointed to a candidate of science degree. His teaching activity started at Kiev Polytechnic Institute in 1960 as an assistant, then a senior lecturer. In 1964–1971 he was occupied with research activities in Institute of Electrodynamics of Ukrainian Academy of Sciences. In 1968 he defended his Doctor's dissertation in Kiev Polytechnic Institute, and earned Dr. Sci. Tech. degree in 1969. In 1971 he was elected in Kiev Institute of Technology of Light Industry as a head of department of Electrical Engineering, and since 1972 — as a head of department of Automation and Complex Mechanization of Technological Processes. He occupied this post till 2000. In 1973 received an academic degree of the professor. Now Mr. Skripnik occupies an active social position, gives lectures on subject matters, supervises over state budgetary research works, trains postgraduate students, masters and bachelors, is the supervisor of studies of student's scientific conference.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of electron transport in double-barrier structures in high frequency electric fields
abstract: For asymmetric double-barrier resonant-tunneling structures with thin high barriers, the simple expressions describing resonant transitions in the large-signal high-frequency electric fields have been obtained taking into account levels width. The levels width dependence versus amplitude of the intensive high frequency electric field and peculiarities of electron transport near resonant levels centers has been investigated.

articleTitle: Simulation of single-electron devices based on silicon and molecules
abstract: Universality of the developed simulation approach of single-electron devices is shown. Good agreement with experimental data is achieved in this regard for different cases.

articleTitle: Plasma and plasmic nanostructures diagnostics: Inverse problem solution by a waveguide probe
abstract: The method of an inverse problem for diagnostics and measurement of plasma and plasmic nanostructure parameters by the waveguide probe is considered.

articleTitle: Two-mirror open waveguides with periodical irregularities
abstract: The electrodynamic characteristics of modifications of a two-mirror open waveguide (OW) with periodical irregularities were analyzed. The recommendations of implementation of such open waveguides in existent devices were given.

articleTitle: Wire antennas for Mobile Satellite Communications and Navigation
abstract: In this paper are introduced wire antennas for Mobile Satellite Communications (MSC) and Navigation. The wire antenna solutions are usually low and near medium gain antenna usefully for MSC. In many respects this types of the Mobile Satellite Antenna (MSA) infrastructures are currently available for MSC and Navigation. Medium and high gain MSA need to track the satellite, following both movements of mobiles and satellite orbital motions. Sometimes this is difficult and expensive to synchronize and have to be introduced in the understanding manner. The vehicular antenna with a low gain does not need to perform tracking but the capacity of the communications link is limited. In such a way, all MSA are classified into omnidirectional or not directional and directional or antennas with tracking system. The Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) and Non-GEO current and forthcoming mobile satellite operators have conducted research on all network segments, including different types of MSA and their future development and improvements. The special types of MSA related to the kind of transportation system, such as maritime, land, aeronautical and transportable or portable mobile antenna types are classified. The common types of different low gain or omnidirectional antennas and some of medium gain or directional antennas are introduced in the technical ways as of importance for MSC.

articleTitle: The radiating structure based on an inverted strip dielectric waveguide
abstract: The experimental investigation results of the radiating structure based on an inverted strip dielectric waveguide are presented. This structure has suitable radiation characteristics in millimeter band.

articleTitle: Solid-state autonomous semiconductor 8-mm wave length power limiter designed for operation at input pulsed power up to 1 KW
abstract: The results of development of the autonomous semiconductor 8-mm wave length power limiter based on p-i-n — diodes matrix on Si and GaAs are presented. The device provides capacity for operation at input power up to 1 kW and at impulse power value over 0.7 W and response speed about 0.2 μs.

articleTitle: OH maser lines observations of comets at an 18-cm wavelength by means of RT-22
abstract: The RT-22 allowed starting investigation of comets in the OH line at the wavelength of 18 cm. Observations of 9P/Tempel1 and Lulin C/2007 N3 comets have been performed, and an original technique for observation data analysis has been developed. The gas production (OH) has been estimated. We plan to continue our program of monitoring the OH radiation of bright comets with the RT-22 radio telescope.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic precursors of global seismic activity in the VLF range
abstract: The possibility of detecting VLF effects from earthquakes has been studied experimentally in a seismically quiet region. A possible mechanism for the super long-distance propagation of the disturbance has been examined.

articleTitle: Influence of meso-substituted tetraphenylporphyrin derivatives molecular structure on their supramolecular organization in bulk samples and fhin films
abstract: In order to study the influence of molecular structure features on their supramolecular organization in the bulk samples and thin films 10 new meso-substituted tetraphenylporphine derivatives and their metal complexes with substitution in para — or ortho-positions (-OC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</inf> or -OC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</inf>) were examined. The dependence of mesomorphic properties of bulk samples from the structure of porphyrins and the position of substituents, their supramolecular organization in thin films and the absorption spectra of Langmuir-Blodgett films in the visible region were studied.

articleTitle: Formation of nanoclusters in the process of nanostructured films formation
abstract: The influence of gas flow speed, hydrides concentration in the reaction zone and the temperature of substrate on the process of formation of germanium nanoclusters and the solid silicon-germanium (Si-Ge) solution is estimated.

articleTitle: The first submarine cable line «Varna — Balaklava»
abstract: Described the history of establishment during the Crimean campaign of submarine cable line "Varna - Bala-clava", which has become one of the longest pretransatlantic period line (1850-1857 years). For the first time in Russian historiography considered negative consequences for the commanders of the British and French armies, which arising from use of the new communication form. One of the more interesting if frequently overlooked technological achievements of the Crimean War is the story of how a converted merchant ship, led by an armed hydrographic vessel and escorted by a warship, reeled out an underwater telegraph cable between Varna and Balaclava by "R. S. Newall & Com-pany" in April 1855. The 300 mile-long cable was longer than any ever previously attempted. Supported by new electrical technology and unique ship's machinery, these pioneers enabled virtually instant communication between the British and French field commanders and their respective sovereigns. In the scientific revolution introduced new facts that create a holistic picture of the radio technologies history in Crimea.

articleTitle: Receiver model basic parameters of a mobile multiservice network with allocated services
abstract: In this work mobile multi-service network receiver model parameters are determined. Their values are calculated. Services central station allocation concept is presented. The further researches will be pointed at bandpass filter parameters and parasitic channels selective properties in the receiver model.

articleTitle: Features of modeling and taking into account of radiating losses in near-field microwave microscopy
abstract: The features of numerical modeling of electromagnetic interaction of coaxial probe aperture of a near-field microwave microscope with a material environment are considered taking into account radiating effects. The approach to construction of a valid computer model of an electrodynamic system of “sensor — object” type for its study by a finite element method is proved taking into account radiating losses.

articleTitle: Phase relations versus frequency re-tuning in oscillator on basis of MSW filter
abstract: The results of study of interrelation of structural elements of MSW oscillator with its performance are presented. The dependence of operating band versus the length of a line in a ring of a feedback of the oscillator is shown. It has been proved that the operating band, the phase drop and the slope of a phase characteristic in the area of MSW filter remain practically constant in the process of frequency re-tuning of the filter. The requirements of MSW filter in the feedback loop of the oscillator have been defined. The substantial influence of phase relationship in the feedback loop on maximum possible band of re-tuning of the oscillator has been submitted.

articleTitle: Software project management
abstract: The structural analysis of technology project management is carried out and relationships between the processes of management are established. Formalization is accomplished and the mathematical model of software project management is proposed.

articleTitle: Investigation of recombination process at photoluminescence in semicoductor materials with the help of microwave-method
abstract: With the help of EPR-method and complex research of optical and electrical properties the recombination process at photoluminescence in ZnS:Al crystals has been investigated.

articleTitle: C-band amplifier on GaN QMIC with output power of 25 W
abstract: In this paper the results of development of GaN quasi-monolithic IC (QMIC) of C-band power amplifier and a module of an open-frame hybrid-integral amplifier with output power of 25 W based on it are presented. The design of QMIC, the amplifier module and the experimental results are shown.

articleTitle: Optimization of the topology of the X-band power amplifier
abstract: X-band amplifier with output power of 14–15 W, efficiency more than 25% and gain more 14 dB is developed. Testing results are presented.

articleTitle: Combined two-band models of resonant tunneling structures
abstract: It was shown that a good agreement of the simulation results with the experimental data can be obtained with the use of proposed combined two-band models of resonant tunneling structures.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the scenario of transition to broadband oscillations in low-voltage vircator
abstract: A detailed experimental study of the transition from single-frequency to broadband generation in the laboratory model of low-voltage vircator have carried out. It was established that the transition to the chaotic oscillation transition occurs through a cascade of period doubling bifurcations. Thus, the studied laboratory model of low-voltage vircator is a generator of controllable chaotic oscillations.

articleTitle: The near-field microwave microscopy of nanometer metal layers
abstract: The description of near-field microwave microscope based on the semiconductor Gunn-diode autodyne oscillator is presented. The probe of the microwave microscope was created on the base on the waveguide-to-microcoaxial adapter with a centre conductor jutted out of the outer conductor. Using the created autodyne near-field microwave microscope the microwave imaging with high space resolution was demonstrated. The relief and electrophysical properties of the ceramic plate surface with the applied metal layer were imaged.

articleTitle: Transformation of normal waves in cavity chains with two coupling slots in the change of their form and sizes
abstract: The phenomena of normal waves interaction in cavity-type periodic systems ("comb-square" and a coupled cavity chain with two slots), similar in a configuration and the sizes are experimentally studied. The results of the wave spectrum transformation analysis of the systems under study, as their dimensions vary, are given.

articleTitle: Orotrons of the 140GHz–300GHz frequency range with two lectron beams
abstract: The experimental investigation of the orotron's efficiency improvement in 140GHz–300GHz frequency range by introducing in its interaction space an additional electron beam over the upper row of a double-row periodic structure (DRPS) is carried out. The electrodynamic system is formed by an open resonator consisted of one plane mirror on which the (DRPS) is settled down and other focusing mirror having the shape of a multifocal spherical mirror. The longitudinal axis of the mirror is parallel to the axis of DRPS symmetry. The multi-focal mirror is formed by 4 crossed spherical surfaces with the general plane of symmetry along the device interaction space. It is shown that such possibility may be successfully realized.

articleTitle: Active receiver for spaceborne SAr calibration and validation
abstract: The variant of an active monitoring station structure for SAR validation and calibration tasks is proposed. It can also be used as a part of a hardware-in-the-loop workbench, a far-field antenna range, and for SAR flight tests as well.

articleTitle: Development of methods for signal processing of acoustic sounding of the atmosphere to predict the conditions of radiowave propagation
abstract: The comprehensive approach to the problem of determining the conditions of radiowave propagation is presented. It involves the preparation of ground meteorological data and sodar data, and the subsequent preparation of the forecast. To verify the approach the data of measurements and various variants of mathematical treatment were used.

articleTitle: Nanocomposite materials polimer-carbon
abstract: Dielectric properties of carbon-polymer composite materials are considered, and their temperature dependences at the different part carbon content in composites. The results of experimental studies are given.

articleTitle: Non energetic IR-UWB receiver and its Noise immunity
abstract: A new method of reception and a receiver of IR-UWB signals are proposed. Noise immunity of the receiver has been evaluated.

articleTitle: Analysis of resonant trasducer characteristics for a scanning microwave microscope
abstract: The analysis of the change of transfer functions of the resonator transducer designed for the use in the microwave scanning microscope, depending on the structural elements of elements due to a transmission line and a probe structure, is carried out.

articleTitle: Influence of automatic control systems on radio receiver interference stability
abstract: Receiver characteristics of selectivity and the signal/noise ratio are presented. It is shown, that for an estimation of penetration of interference in a receiver it is necessary to conduct detailed researches to determination of the equivalent frequency characteristic of the receiver with tracking automatic control systems.

articleTitle: Software for measurement automation, deembedding and small-signal FET model extraction
abstract: Software programs for on-wafer measurement automation of multibias S-parameters, deembedding, and extraction of MESFET and HEMT small signal models is developed. The programs are included into software system INDE-SYS-MS that is integrated with on-wafer measurement setup.

articleTitle: Estimation of mean queue length in a buffer of telecommunication equipment at serving fractal traffic
abstract: A model of fractal traffic based on the ARFIMA model has been considered. A way to estimate mean queue length in a buffer of telecommunication equipment that is necessary to serve traffic properly has been suggested.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of the materials quality parameters in the microwave range
abstract: We consider two methods of electromagnetic diagnostics of substances by determining both their complex permittivity and the attenuation of electromagnetic energy passing through a layer of the substance. The relationship for the updated definition of the VSWR great values is offered.

articleTitle: Simulation of MIMO communication system
abstract: Simulations were made to compare the interference immunity characteristics of manipulation codes which were set out in [1] with both formally known codes and codes obtained using a random search algorithm. In this paper the influence of the characteristics of all three communication channels (source-transponder, source-receiver and transponder-receiver) on efficiency metrics of the systems using these introduced methods was analyzed.

articleTitle: Experimental test bench for investigation of metamaterials in the millimeter waveband
abstract: Description of the designed experimental stand for investigation of properties of metamaterials including left-handed media in open space and results of model experiments in the millimeter waveband is given.

articleTitle: The output circuit of inverse class F power amplifier with slot resonators in the microstrip line ground plane
abstract: The modeling results of class F<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> power amplifier on GaN transistor NPTB00004 at operating frequency 1.6 GHz are presented. As a harmonics filter circuit the structure based of slot resonators in microstrip line ground plane was used. Modeling results had shown the drain efficiency and output power of the class F<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> power amplifier at operating frequency 59% and 6 W correspondingly.

articleTitle: The study of non-stationary dynamics of virtual cathode in the helical electron flow
abstract: The numerical study of the complex dynamics of the helical electron flow in the mode of the formation of virtual cathode has been made.

articleTitle: Method of the biomedical electrode equivalent parameters' measurement
abstract: The method, hardware and software for equivalent circuit parameters measurement are developed. Described circuit model includes the resistance and capacitance of the electrode and the tissues' resistance. The design of the measuring device is simple and do not have tuning elements. Experimental results applying to capacitive biomedical electrodes are obtained.

articleTitle: Simultaneous determination of electrical conductivity and thickness of the semiconductor layers in the dielectric-semiconductor structures as per microwave reflection spectra
abstract: The present paper confirms possibility of determination of conductivity and thickness of semiconductor layers as per results of measurements of frequency dependence of a reflection factor of electromagnetic microwave radiation at different temperature values. The appropriate inverse problem solution technique is proposed.

articleTitle: Dual band amplifier with subterahertz surface and bulk waves
abstract: The subterahertz amplifier with two input signals is considered. Theoretical analysis is performed on the basis of nonlinear multidimensional theory of the beam-wave interaction. Conditions of the regenerative amplification and locking on the first and third harmonics of the surface wave frequency are obtained.

articleTitle: Input resistance of impedance monopole on spherical scatterer
abstract: An expression for input impedance of a radial impedance monopole placed on a conducting sphere and exited by a voltage generator (at its base), is derived by means of the generalized method of induced EMF. The zeroth-order approximation of asymptotic solution of integro-differential equation for current of the monopole, obtained by iteration technique, is used as a base function.

articleTitle: Occurrence conditions of the radar reflections in troposphere caused by the convective thermal heterogeneities
abstract: The results of an annual cycle of radar convective thermal heterogeneities observations in troposphere are discussed. The dependence of number of these phenomena vs. meteorological parameters is considered. It is shown that their number to the greatest degree depends on the value of diurnal variation of temperature.

articleTitle: Influence of intermediated Ag layer on formation of L10(FePt) phase in nanodimensional Fe50Pt50/Ag/Fe50Pt50 film compositions on oxided silicon single-crystal substrate
abstract: The influence of intermediated Ag layer on structural transformations in nanodimensional Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>Pt<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>(15 nm)/Ag(x nm)/Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>Pt<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>(15 nm)/ SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(100 nm)/Si(001) (where x - 0 nm, 3 nm, 30 nm) film compositions (NFC) and their magnetic properties after annealing in vacuum was studied.

articleTitle: Exciton effects in multilayer super lattice
abstract: This work deals with a variation method for estimation of the exciton binding energy in the multilayer super lattice of the first type. The binding energy dependence on the super lattice design and technological parameters, i.e. a quantum well region width, dividing barrier region width, the dividing barrier energy height, a number of quantum limited regions presenting the super lattice, is shown. The results of simulation coincide well with experimental data in the middle of the designed parameters calculation ranges.

articleTitle: Nikolay Alekseyev and Dmitry Malyarov — Lifelines of inventors of multiresonator magnetron
abstract: Principle of magnetron had been known before the designing of a cavity magnetron. But then in twenties-thirties it had been only about rather low power. Devices of Alekseev and Malyarov on 10 cm wave produced 300 Watt - it was an unprecedented experience. Due to their publication in 1940 a powerful impulse was given to the development of magnetrons and radio locators of centimeter range all over the world. In all information sources Alekseev and Malyarov have been assigned among the inventors of a multiresonator magnetron, but until recently their destinies have been unknown. The results of investigations, pursued in Central museum of communication named after A. S. Popov on request of foreign colleagues are presented in the report. It was defined that both inventors had faced the war in Leningrad. In autumn and in December 1941 they were still working with radar equipment in blockaded city. In the beginning of 1942 Alekseev was evacuated to Moscow, where a new lamp manufacturing was being organized. His further occupation was associated with Moscow Aeronautical Institute. Malyarov died in 1942 in blockaded Leningrad.

articleTitle: Study of electromagnetic compatibility of DVB-T (channel 64) and IS-95 systems in 800 MHz band deployed in Ukraine
abstract: The electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) between television channel 64 of the digital terrestrial television DVB-T system and IS-95 (Reverse Channel) in the range of 800 MHz was studied by means of the Minimum Coupling Loss method (MCL). Protective distances were calculated. The theoretical simulation in a software tool Seamcat 3.2.2 was produced using the Monte-Carlo method.

articleTitle: 130 GHz QPSK radiosystem simulation
abstract: Nowadays the speed of wire lines has reached the value of 100 Gb/s. Such tendency entails the necessity to create new generation wireless systems, which would be able to pass gygabit flows on distances in a few kilometres. Although, there are radiosystems working on frequencies over 100 GHz already, however they use ASK modulation that is spectral and power inefficient. In the following article, a wireless system with QPSK modulation is investigated on frequency 130 GHz using AWR software. Study results are given as well.

articleTitle: Forecasting of time series on the basis of wavelet transformation and neural networks
abstract: Problems of development of a time series combined with forecasting technique on the basis of wavelet-transformation with neural networks application are studied.

articleTitle: Genetic-algorithm-based synthesis of matching networks accounting for element losses and parasitics
abstract: A genetic-algorithm-based approach to the synthesis of matching networks (MNs) is investigated using different types of passive element models such as simple Q-models, equivalent circuit (EC) models, and S-parameter-based models. The approach is implemented in the automatic synthesis software INDESYS-MATCH.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of microwave grazing incidence reflectivity technique of conductor study
abstract: Non-resonant method of investigation of conducting materials including high temperature superconductors (HTS) at grazing angles of incidence of the electromagnetic wave on a sample under test is described. The results of comparative analysis of reflection (for oblique short circuit termination) and transmission coefficient (for corner bend) of the electromagnetic wave in the measuring sections with a sample under test for waveguide sections are presented.

articleTitle: Estimation of wireless network time-probabilistic characteristics based on AODV, DSR, OLSR, TORA routing protocols
abstract: The present article concerns a simulation model of mobile wireless networks. Estimation of network parameters in such routing protocols as AODV, DSR, OLSR, and TORA is also carried out.

articleTitle: A resonance system for investigating cylindrical dielectrics in the millimeter wavelength range
abstract: An approximate mathematical model of an open resonator consisting of spherical and flat reflectors is constructed. A segment of an oversized circular waveguide is in the center of the flat reflector along the resonator axis over its full length of the dielectric cylindrical rod is located.

articleTitle: Output network of the microwave doherty amplifier on MESFET CLY5
abstract: The 800-MHz Doherty power amplifier (PA) using MESFET's CLY 5 was developed. Design technique of the output network is considered in detail and its calculation, simulation and prototype's experimental investigation are carried out. S-parameters measurement is implemented in frequency band using Agilent vector analyzer and good agreement between calculated and experimental data is obtained.

articleTitle: Compact high-voltage source for pulse periodic range accelerator
abstract: Experimental study of a Tesla transformer (TT), intended for high-voltage power supply of subrelativistic electron devices is carried out. Tuning technique of TT and obtained experimental data are considered.

articleTitle: The research method of biological tissue permittivity
abstract: Developed hardware-software system for studies of the dielectric properties of biological tissues, allowing estimating the relative change in concentration of glucose in the fluid at a constant salt concentration. Researched the influence of relative concentration of glucose in the water on the resonance properties of the loop antenna. Based on the theoretical and experimental results the test equipment accuracy requirements are determined to be used in glucose concentration measuring.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal excitation of λ/4 helicon resonance in ferrite-semiconductor composite resonator
abstract: The possibility of excitation of λ/4 helicon resonance in a composite YIG-InSb resonator at 67.8 GHz frequency is discussed. The waveguide cell shows at the resonant frequency of nonreciprocal absorption of 22 dB and SWR ≈ 1.8 at room temperature and magnetic field of 4.9 kOe.

articleTitle: A powerful microwave monotron-generator with a four-gap cavity driving on cophased mode
abstract: The main goal of this publication is computational modeling of operating conditions and determination of optimal parameters for a four-gap cavity with co-phased oscillation mode that provides maximum value of electronic efficiency for multibeam monotron. A monotron generator that has multi-beam structure and common four-gap resonator is able to provide high efficiency (up to 60%) and output power, small overall dimensions and weight.

articleTitle: Efficient combiner for transmitters with close frequencies
abstract: The possible ways of reducing of power losses into the combiner of two or more transmitters working with the same antenna due to its complexity are considered. The possibility of development of the antenna system with similar amplitude and different phase partial radiation patterns is shown for two or more transmitters with overlapped frequency ranges.
