articleTitle: On the possibility of generating low frequency whistlers in the lower ionosphere during the disturbances of different nature
abstract: It is experimentally shown that low frequency whistlers can be generated using the infrasound produced by heavy thunderstorm in the atmosphere and by powerful atmospheric fronts during the seasonal changes of the year.

articleTitle: The meteor trail radio physical model with the specular reflection point
abstract: The radio physical model to estimate coherent and incoherent components of the signal scattered by the turbulent meteor trail with the point of specular reflection is proposed.

articleTitle: Luminescence structures on the basis of porous anodic alumina
abstract: In the present paper luminescence from aluminium oxide synthesized in a form of xerogel powders and films doped with terbium, porous anodic alumina with terbium ions deposited from the solution of salt, depending on annealing temperature and terbium concentration is investigated.

articleTitle: Fabrication of porous alumina with tubular structure
abstract: Fabrication of porous nanostructured alumina by electrochemical anodization has been investigated. Porous alumina films with the tubular structure and the tube diameter from 60 nm to 400 nm and the porosity 1-2% have been formed.

articleTitle: Coordination of Ukrainian satellite networks in planned band BSS (position 38.2° E)
abstract: The example of an obtainment of a frequency-orbital resource for Ukrainian national satellite system is described.

articleTitle: Features of design frequency synthesizer for information systems
abstract: The cardinal problem of designing and constructing frequency synthesizers is the inevitable rise in output noise when extending the frequency range. The aim of the research is to extend the PLL synthesizers frequency range that will be able to employ the sequential mode of functioning for radio communications, diagnostics and control systems.

articleTitle: Method of exciting dielectric resonators by non-symmetric stripline
abstract: The method for the excitation of the system of cylindrical dielectric resonators by a microstrip line using their orthogonal mutual orientation is presented. The design of a dielectric resonator antenna based on such an excitation method is described. An approach to determining antenna characteristics is stated. The results of antenna characteristics measurements are stated.

articleTitle: Telephone traffic delay simulation in NGN routers
abstract: An algorithm for priority queuing (PQ) for an output channel router in IP networks is considered.

articleTitle: Radiofrequency method for mass determination of two-phase substance in closed cylindrical reservoir
abstract: Radiofrequency method for highly accurate mass determination of two-phase single-component substance in a closed cylindrical reservoir is considered. Measured results are unrelated with a phase state of a substance.

articleTitle: Nitride gallium high power integrated heterostructure FETS
abstract: The heterostructures AlGaN/AlN/GaN, grown on the sapphire substrates, the design of the integrated power HFET and its technology have been developed. HFETs have given the output power 7.57 W/mm, power efficiency (PE = 43.5 %) and power gain 5.6 dB at the frequency of 12 GHz.

articleTitle: On the miniaturization of generators of broadband noise-like oscillations
abstract: In this paper the schemes of small-sized ultra-low-voltage generators of broadband microwave oscillations are considered. Experimental results of various modes of study designs are given.

articleTitle: Biological properties of water exposed to GSM-1800 EM radiation, passed through a polyethylene film
abstract: The bottled spring water preliminarily exposed to GSM-1800 mobile phone radiation was used for watering of wheat grain. The number of shoots decreased considerably and they were worse developed. In comparison with this result the exposed water, wrapped by thin (40 μm) four-layered polyethylene film (PF) influenced the number of shoots and their growth positively. It is supposed that the PF action is similar to its well-known action to the fast neutrons passage. It can be assumed that little-known quantum properties of the EM radiation together with the supplementing properties of water are responsible for the non-thermal biological effects.

articleTitle: Compact antenna for radiation of super-power broadband pulses
abstract: The compact antenna for powerful autonomous portable wide-band systems used, in particular, for studying of electromagnetic compatibility problems was designed. In the given paper some characteristics and results of experiments from this ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna are presented.

articleTitle: Simultaneous observation of magnetostatic backward volume wave and surface wave resonances in single crystal barium hexaferrite platelets with in-plane c-axis
abstract: Resonances attributed to simultaneous excitation of magnetostatic backward volume waves and surface waves were observed for a platelet of barium hexaferrite with in-plane uniaxial easy direction c-axis. It was shown that backward volume wave resonances can be magnetically tuned over 50-62 GHz with a bias magnetic field of 5.5 kOe, a much smaller bias than in the case of a barium hexaferrite plate with c-axis perpendicular to plane. Theoretical estimates are qualitatively in agreement with the data. Some discrepancies between theory and data are attributed to electromagnetic propagation effects.

articleTitle: Application of AFM methods to control technological operations in the process of manufacturing phosphide-based hetero-bipolar transistors
abstract: It was shown that modern AFM methods of controlling geometry and physical parameters of semiconductor InP/InGaAs/InP heterostructures can be successfully applied in manufacturing of modern UHF DHBT-transistors with narrow base (< 100 nm). Operational control of geometric and physical parameters of heterostucture in intervals between carrying out technological operations allows controlling more effectively their manufacture and production.

articleTitle: Synchronization of oscillations induced by noise in klystron autogenerator on excitation treshold
abstract: This paper presents the experimental data of noise resonant response synchronization by an external harmonic signal. It has been shown that synchronization of klystron amplifier output signal in coherence resonance regime leads to signal/noise ratio increase.

articleTitle: Development of THZ-range gyrotrons for detection of concealed radioactive materials
abstract: The design of 0.67 THz/200 kW pulsed gyrotron for detecting concealed radioactive materials is presented. The coil with liquid nitrogen cooling and solenoid power supply was successfully tested.

articleTitle: Bandpass and Bandstop filters on lattices of dielectric resonators in planar waveguide of infrared wavelength range
abstract: The possibility of realization of Bandpass and Bandstop filters of terahertz wavelength range made on the basis of dielectric resonators (DR) of spherical form with the lowest modes of magnetic azimuthal symmetric oscillations H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">101</inf> has been considered. For filters contained a large number of DRs with low dielectric permittivity, the electrodynamics models of filters have been developed. Frequency characteristics of investigated filters, passing and reflection parameters were obtaned. The possibility of obtainment of acceptable scattering parameters on densely packed 1-D structures of coupling resonators in the planar waveguide has been shown.

articleTitle: Signal discretization with infinite spectrum
abstract: The technique of signal discretization with infinite spectrum is considered. The equation for determination of discretization interval is obtained.

articleTitle: Estimated model of radio propagation in the microwave range
abstract: A mathematical model of propagation over the Earth's surface in the microwave range is developed. This model does not take into account the characteristics of the relief along the propagation path and can be used only for the initial evaluation of the service area or radiointerference zone.

articleTitle: Investigation of radiowave propagation models based on a three dimentional parabolic equation
abstract: A problem of radio wave propagation modeling over the Earth surface in approximation of parabolic equation is investigated. The features of three-dimensional model and the dependences of prediction results on the size of the considered domain, the numerical scheme and the parameters of the transmitter are analyzed. There was made a comparison with known theoretical results for a case of a triangular hill and with prediction results of a two-dimensional model.

articleTitle: Attenuation of millimeter-wave radiation in composites with carbon nanotubes
abstract: The interaction of millimeter-wave radiation (MWR) with epoxy polymers filled with multiwalled carbon nano-tubes (MWCNT) with inclusive Co and Fe nanoparticles has been investigated. High absorption of MWR in such composites has been revealed. It can be referred to the broad-band natural FMR induced by a high local magnetic anisotropy in nanoparti-cles inside the carbon nanotubes.

articleTitle: Investigation of digitalization of analogue RRL
abstract: On the basis of conducted analysis of existent ways of technical solutions and methods of digitalization of analogue RRL the perspective of application of combined (two-level) modulation has been shown. The developed method of characterization of distortions, caused by the influence of unrestricted parameters of radio-relay equipment, is submitted.

articleTitle: Priority tasks for operation efficiency increase of the wireless communication networks with distributed adaptive antenna systems
abstract: The priority tasks for efficiency increase of the wireless communication networks (WCS) with distributed antenna systems (DAS) operation are stated.

articleTitle: Modelling and optimization of Shottky diode design for protective devices
abstract: Simulation of electronics in vertical Shottky diode for protection devices is carried out. Various types of optimal design are proposed.

articleTitle: Multi-criterion routing problem in multi-service communication networks using the composition of quality indicators
abstract: Some practical features of multi-criterion approach to solving the problem of optimal routing in a multiservice network are considered. A network model is chosen as a multimode graph containing a set of nodal points and communication links. We have found a set of Pareto-optimal routing variants including an aggregate of quality indicators.

articleTitle: Analysis of the electromagnetic response of flat samples by the quasioptical method in the frequencie range 26–37.5GHz
abstract: The procedure improving accuracy of determination of the electromagnetic response and permittivity of flat materials is offered by a quasioptical method at use of analogue scalar network analyzers.

articleTitle: Monopulse horn array antennas for space-based radar
abstract: An electrodynamics model for the monopulse horn array antennas is developed. The directional characteristics of array antennas are presented.

articleTitle: Installation for efficient microwave heating of metals
abstract: The installation for high-temperature heating of conductors with low conductivity is developed. The cavity cabinet of the installation is a coaxial resonator with TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">010</sub> oscillations. The calculation, optimization, tuning and investigation of the cavity were conducted. An experimental investigation of microwave plasma torch was performed at microwave power 600 watts. Prospects of high-temperature microwave heating are shown.

articleTitle: ALGaN/GaN phemt transistors on SiC substrate
abstract: The article concerns the development and practical realization results of AlGaN/GaN transistors on SiC substrate. The measured parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Monolithic microwave ICs of limiter based on pin-and shottky diodes
abstract: The results of the development of protective devices MMIC's based on pin-diodes and Schottky diodes are presented for the frequency band 1-22 GHz. The circuit features low insertion loss at the operating frequency band, leakage power is less than 11.5 dBm and it can handle continuous microwave power levels up to 37 dBm.

articleTitle: Investigation into the functional state of a human being using the pulsed gas-discharge visualization
abstract: The results obtained from developing a breadboard model of the device intended to examine the functional health state of a human being via the gas-discharge visualization are presented. Preliminary studies have been made using the device already developed. It is shown that the proposed system can be chosen as a base tool for further studies.

articleTitle: Influence of ionizing radiation on electric characteristics of power n-MOSFETS
abstract: The results of experimental researches of radiation resistance of power n-MOSFETs at influence of gamma-irradiation Co<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup> are submitted.

articleTitle: The electromagnetic field application for biosystems development control aboard space stations
abstract: Compensation opportunities of the space negative influence on a phytosystem in conditions of orbital space stations are considered. Influences of microgravitation, the gas environment and a water mode are taken into account as well as the influence of fields of the various kinds and, first of all, E-field radiation of mm-range of wavelengths at all stages of physiological evolution of plants. Microgravitation of space stations influences on phytosystem (vegetative systems) and breaks physiology of their development. Development of plants depends on influence of electrostatic and electromagnetic fields. The resulted laws show, that microgravitation can be compiled by influence of E-field radiation in mm-range of wavelengths.

articleTitle: Standard technologies for microvawe electronics: Challenges and prospects
abstract: Results obtained by “Svetlana-Rost” JSC while developing full-cycle foundry service for Russian market, are viewed. Based on standard technologies with crucial dimension of 0.5 microns, examples of microwave devices and acoustic resonators realization are presented.

articleTitle: Self-aligned T-gate pHEMT
abstract: Self-aligned 0.25 μm T-gate pHEMT technology is described in this paper. Basic requirements of self-aligned technology for gate profile are presented. Metallization system and annealing parameters providing low-resistance ohmic contacts are chosen. Current-voltage characteristics and current gain of routine and self-aligned pHEMT are compared. The self-aligned technology provides an increase in transconductance S and drive current I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</inf> of 10…15% comparing with routine process. Cutoff frequency increased by 15 GHz and reached F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf>∼70 GHz.

articleTitle: On beam focusing enhancing in klistrone at large signal mode
abstract: A new design of solenoid for klystrons is considered. The design enables significant increasing of the magnetic field in the tube output part.

articleTitle: Onboard active antenna arrays with digital signal processing. Prospects of development
abstract: The new applications of DSP in active phased antenna arrays are considered. Such tasks as broadband, super focus, loss reduction by elimination of the analog channel of microwave devices.

articleTitle: Coaxial gyroklinotron
abstract: A new kind of gyrotron - coaxial gyroklinotron with a conical cavity is presented. In such gyrotron with coaxial-conical configuration of the cavity the inclination of a surface level of electromagnetic field relating to longitudinal motion of electrons is formed. As a result, at sufficiently large length of the interaction area and the optimal configuration of coaxial - conical cavity all radial layers of the electron beam crossing through the level surface are on average at the equal conditions of interaction with the cavity field. Presented in the paper results of numerical simulation and design optimization of coaxial gyroklinotron with conical cavity are the evidence of its feasibility and prospects for a substantial increase of power of short-wave gyrotrons. Average electronic efficiency of coaxial gyroklinotron with a wide electron beam reaches 22.57% at mode H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">04</sub> of conical cavity.

articleTitle: Method of design of dual frequency equal-arm power dividers on basis of coupled-lines
abstract: The generalized circuit of an equal-arm power divider on basis of segments of coupled lines for operation at two arbitrary frequencies is offered. Analytical expressions, which were obtained, enable to develop the methods for computation of dividers with different structure. The examples of application of such approach for some variants of circuit are presented.

articleTitle: Spectral-phase parameters and Q-factor of microstrip directional filters
abstract: Analysis of frequency spectrum, phase parameters and Q-factor of microstrip directional filter of traveling-wave is presented.

articleTitle: Analog-digital converter with sampling rate in 1100 MSPS
abstract: The technical fulfillment of ADC, which consists of two ADS S4RF63 chips and allows processing the input band in 0.5 GHz with dynamic range of 60 dB, is presented.

articleTitle: Potential properties of radar signals formed by some types of polarization modulation
abstract: The features of some radar signals with a double orthogonal polarization are considered. The radiated signals are formed by modulation of their polarization parameters. Some of these potential properties and the procedure of estimating some elements of a dispersion matrix (DM) of an object after the orthogonal components of such signal have been compressed.

articleTitle: Analysis of electrodynamic stabilized cavities with quantum dots in HFSS
abstract: The results of electrodynamic studies of the proposed transmitter of optical range, containing a semiconductor structure with quantum dots. The electrodynamic system of the transmitter consists of a set of quarter-wave peripheral resonators and a stabilizing coaxial resonator in the central part. Analysis was performed using the program HFSS.

articleTitle: Digital compensation of nonlinearity of the bridging amplifier in DVB-T television signal transmitter
abstract: The technical solutions of digital compensation of nonlinearity of a bridging amplifier in DVB-T television signal transmitter are presented.

articleTitle: Manipulation codes for communication systems with MIMO
abstract: This paper sets out a method of construction of manipulation codes for communication systems with retransmission using the concept of cooperative MIMO. This method is based on genetic algorithms for a binary switching. With the help of this method we developed manipulation codes for constellation diagrams 16QAM, 32QAM and 64QAM, which characteristics are the best with high probability.

articleTitle: Influence of the nonlinear bias dependence of the barrier height on measured Schottky-barrier contact parameters
abstract: A numerical investigation of current-voltage characteristics (IVCs) of the metal-semiconductor Schottky-barrier contact (SBC) considering the influence of image force and tunneling effects is presented. The analysis is carried out on the basis of a model, taking into account the nonlinear bias dependence of the barrier height.

articleTitle: Modeling of influence of shock fluctuations in transistor microwave oscillators
abstract: The problems of computer modeling concerning the influence of shock fluctuations of starting current in the oscillatory contour upon auto-oscillatory process development in pulse generators and super-regenerative transceivers are considered.

articleTitle: Construction of wideband waveguide reflector on 120–180 GHz frequency range
abstract: The results of designing and experimental research of microwave waveguide reflector, using principle of evanescent-mode waveguide are presented.

articleTitle: X-band narrow-beam wide-band antenna
abstract: The broadband, narrow-beam, linear antenna array (AA) of X band was developed. The main AA parameters are: the beam width in horizontal plane is 1° (on frequency 9430 MHz), in vertical plane 32°, gain 30 dB, bandwidth of the radiated (received) signal is 800 MHz, central operating frequency is 9430 MHz.

articleTitle: Metallization on the basis of binary and ternary alloys for submicron elements of MEMS RF-microswitches formation
abstract: Features of suspended elements of microme-chanical structures at transition to the submicron size formation are considered. It is shown, that suspended elements of micro-mechanical structures are exposed to the greatest deforming influence during sacrificial layer removing. The ways with the submicron sizes are offered.

articleTitle: Level estimation of the cumulative interference from the group of LTE mobile stations
abstract: The computational method for cumulative interference level created by a group of subscriber's stations of an overland mobile service of the 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> generation of LTE standard is offered. Recommendations on calculation of a level of the uniform spectral density by equivalent to cumulative interference affecting from a group of subscriber's stations are resulted. Outcomes allow extending known estimation procedures of an interference level on the radio device using SC-FDMA.

articleTitle: Examination into authorship of radio engineering term "antenna"
abstract: The results of research of history of radio engineering term "antenna are presented.

articleTitle: Communication system based on UHF-radio communication and Ethernet technology
abstract: The present paper concerns a designed communication network combining two modes of information transfer - radio-frequency and digital. The system is based on the information transfer by the Ethernet technology with the further transformation of the digital data flow into the analog signal for the purpose of its UHF-range transmission. The system operates both for transmission and reception of radio-frequency signals, then transformed into digital.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of characteristics of resonator sensors for SMM of semiconductors
abstract: Analysis of dependence of quality factor of a storage part of widely used resonator sensors for scanning microwave microscopy (SMM) is performed. Analysis is carried out on the results of numerical estimates obtained by solving the problem of finding the resonance oscillations using the finite element method. A comparison with estimates from the approximate formulas and experimental results is realized.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic simulation of performance of microwave devices on basis of higher-order basis functions
abstract: The ways to improve the efficiency of an electromagnetic analysis of passive microwave devices using a vector finite element method based on the application of tangential basis higher-order functions were explored.

articleTitle: Intellectual self-organizing radio networks
abstract: The integrated model of Ad-Hoc network intellectual control system is proposed. Model suggests using of artificial intelligence methods for providing ability of a radio network to self-organization, and also adaptation of network elements to the different operating conditions.

articleTitle: Efficiency increasing methods for orbital satellite survey of randomly located areas
abstract: The basic steps of satellite survey simulating and planning of long and poorly contrast objects with nonzero angular velocities for control efficiency increase of a remote sensing spacecraft with high resolution optoelectronic scanner are described.

articleTitle: The model of the optical tomographic Microscope resolution
abstract: In this work the results of numerical estimations of the Optical Scanning Microscope resolution with tomography method reconstruction of Object Image are presented. Using the Mie theory methods, we analyze the scattering of the illuminated light beam and obtain the resolution limit estimations for UV light and soft X-ray illumination sources. As it is shown the spatial resolution of possible Optical Scanning Microscope can achieve 40-60 nm limit at UV illumination source (λ=206 nm).

articleTitle: Current distribution in relativistic 8 MM magnetron
abstract: Current distribution in relativistic magnetron (RM) of 8-mm wavelength has been studied experimentally and with the help of 3D simulation. Existence of direct and return axial electron flows that sufficiently disturb to the RM operation is considered.

articleTitle: Metallic wire photonic crystals: Electromagnetic simulation of electric properties
abstract: Methods of construction of the dispersive equations of metal photonic crystals and methods of their homogenization are considered. For a number of wire, ring and helix periodic inclusions in a dielectric the effective material parameters are obtained in approach of a small wire thickness.

articleTitle: Ka-band circular wavegude-dielectric antenna
abstract: Ka-band circular waveguide dielectric antenna was created. Antenna performance: - beamwidth is 60° - VSWR less than 1.5 at frequency band 33-35 GHz - isolation between antenna inputs is close to 50-60 dB. Antenna might transmit and receive Ka-band orthogonal signals without a circulator.

articleTitle: The electrodynamic characteristics of a transversal slot radiator based on an inverted strip dielectric waveguide
abstract: The results of experimental investigations of the characteristics of hybrid metal-dielectric structures, which based on a combination of an inverted dielectric waveguide, a segment of a microstrip line and slot discontinuity are observed. The results allow predicting radiating structures designing with high level parameters and good agreement with external circuits as well.

articleTitle: Synthesis and structural properties of ZnS nanostructures
abstract: In this work the technology of deposition of ZnS nanostructures obtained by close-spaced vacuum sublimation technique (CSVS) is described. The some structural properties of these nanostructures are investigated. Examination of layers morphology and structure was performed by high-resolution electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction method respectively. Results of these studies enabled to determine dependence of the main structural film parameters (phase, lattice parameters, grain sizes etc.) on the growth conditions.

articleTitle: The history of radio recounted on the pages of Nautical collected works (1885–1918)
abstract: The cradle out of which the home-base radio originated is the Russian naval forces. While radio as a system of sending sound messages over a certain distance was developing primarily as the commercial project, in Russia, radioteleg-raphy was closely allied to the Navy. One of the key sources that provides the historical background of the home-base fleet is the journal «Nautical collected works». The present communication carries the survey of articles dealing with the historical records of radio engineering, which were published in the «Nau-tical collected works» dated 1885 through 1918.

articleTitle: Main results of the development of mobile digital tropospheric station
abstract: The main results of the development of the mobile digital tropospheric station are presented.

articleTitle: Study of electrodynamic properties of microprobe based on taper coaxial resonator in scanning microwave microscopy
abstract: The electrodynamic properties of resonator probes with a coaxial measuring aperture are researched. The quantitative representations of dependence of sizes of localization, of size of localization of near-field and spatial distribution of its electrical components on geometry of the aperture and the tip shape are given.

articleTitle: Software programs for storage and statistical analysis of MMIC measurement data
abstract: Software programs for storage and statistical analysis of MMIC measurement data are developed. Programs are included in INDESYS-MS system for measurement automation. Information structure in data base and statistical analysis tools are described.

articleTitle: Integration model of cloud and enterprice computing units
abstract: The current state of information technologies requires high-performance processing and storing of large data volumes. To satisfy these constantly growing requirements, leading IT companies provide cloud computing services - pool of abstract, virtualized, highly-scalable resources, available on-demand over Internet. However, this concept still has limitations, which sometimes are too high to give in. Striving for the possible solutions in order to escape such limitations and finding a compromise between flexibility of cloud computing and confidence of local resources is an important step for further development of distributed computing.

articleTitle: Metamaterial substrate for measurement of complex permittivity of liquids using open-ended coaxial-line probes
abstract: The new technique for determination of complex permittivity of a liquid media by open-ended coaxial line probes, based on using metamaterial substrate with known characteristics, is proposed. Following this technique, determination of wide variations of complex permittivity of liquid from only amplitude measurements of a reflection coefficient in a finite frequency range in combination with fitting optimal thickness of a tested layer of liquid is possible.

articleTitle: Construction of distributed mobile systems using MIMO technology
abstract: The principles of constructing distributed mobile systems using the MIMO technology are presented. In addition, the MIMO algorithm operation and the possible energy gain are discussed.

articleTitle: Fabrication peculiarities effect on power fet amplifier output parameters
abstract: The correction data connected with boundary effects in high dielectric constant matching networks of fabrication peculiarities has been obtained. It is shown that fabrication peculiarities can shift amplifier working frequency about 1.5 GHz and three times decrease working frequency band.

articleTitle: The influence of oxide materials on the I-V characterictics of MOSFET's based on carbon nanotubes
abstract: The influence of oxide materials was investigated on the current-voltage characteristics of MOSFET's based on carbon nanotubes with a channel length of 10 nm using a simplified model. It is shown that the best characteristics would have a transistor in which HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is used as a dielectric.

articleTitle: Numerical investigations of the compact oscillator of noise-like chaotic microwave signals with virtual cathode
abstract: The new modification of a compact generator based on a virtual cathode (VC) for generation of noise-type chaotic microwave signals was proposed and investigated with the help of 3D electromagnetic code. It has been shown that realization of compact drift space for the electron beam promotes VC formation and chaotization of output radiation of the generator. The physical processes responsible for the behavior of the VC generator were investigated.

articleTitle: Investigation of temperature dependence of contact resistance for Au-Ti-Pd2Si-n+-Si OHMIC contacts subjected to microwave irradiation
abstract: Based on a theoretical analysis of temperature dependence of contact resistance R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub> for Au-Ti-Pd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Si-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-Si oh-mic contact, a current flow mechanism is proposed that explains the experimentally observed R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub> growth with temperature in the 100-380 K temperature range. It is shown that microwave treatment of such contacts leads to reduction of R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub> values spread over the wafer and decrease of R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub>, while R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub> growth with temperature in the 100-380 K temperature range retains.

articleTitle: Influence of dielectric insertions on broadbandness of a «pure» wave conversion by the cascade of strip diaphragms
abstract: We optimize the cascades of strip diaphragms in a flat overmoded waveguide for the efficient power conversion of the wave TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,0</sub> into the higher wave TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">M,0</sub>. The working frequency band of such devices is considerably increased due to the modifications resulting from useful spectral regimes and due to the influence of dielectric insertions between diaphragms. We also consider a situation, in which the dielectric transmutes an input of the device into the single-mode one.

articleTitle: The 1-mm wavelength orotron with TRPS on the first space harmonic
abstract: The results of the 1 mm wavelength orotron optimization operating on the first space harmonic of a two-row periodic structure (TRPS) are presented. The computer simulation methods of the electron-wave interaction efficiency investigation, which were developed for the orotron at long-wavelength range, are used. The multi-focus sphere-cylinder mirror was used as a focusing mirror. The cylinder longitudinal axis was perpendicular to the broad electron beam direction. The optimal TRPS length dependence on ohmic losses in the open resonator for maximum orotron efficiency is found. The calculations were fulfilled on the bases of the results obtained in paper [1, 3]. It was shown that the quality of the surface treatment of TRPS plays an important role. The higher is the surface quality the shorter is the length of space interaction where the maximum efficiency is achieved and the higher is its value and the value of output power, which can be ten of watts (and more) on the first space harmonic at the broad electron beam with current density of only 35A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The calculations were fulfilled for the transformation coefficient k of HF field of OR to the 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> space harmonic of TRPS at K=2/π and k = 0.2. The decrease of k = 0.2 leads up to TRPS length increase.

articleTitle: Measuring system for interferometric investigation of properties refractive troposphere with his radio emission geostationary
abstract: The results from developing the measuring apparatus on the basis of radio interferometer are described. The apparatus allows obtaining a gradient of the troposphere refraction index with the aid of a geostationary satellite signal. The block diagram, parameters and the results from studying the accuracy of the apparatus are presented. The apparatus parameters thus provide the derived accuracy of the arrival angle, which is required to obtain the gradient of the troposphere refraction index.

articleTitle: Investigation of nanostructured silicon surfaces using fractal analysis
abstract: Fractal analysis was applied to images of nanostructured silicon surfaces which were acquired with a scanning electron microscope. A fractal model describing nanostructured silicon surfaces morphology is elaborated. It were obtained the numerical results for the fractal dimensions for 2 samples with different nanostructured shapes.

articleTitle: Nanoporous silicon combustion process for mems
abstract: Nanostructured porous silicon impregnated by solid state oxidants has been studied in order to provide the combustion process for jet-propulsion microsystems. The pendulum systems with jet-propulsion movement on a silicon chip has been used for impulse measurements. The estimated impulse value is in the range of 1-5 mN·s.

articleTitle: Directions of design of ultrahighspeed radio telecommunication systems with use of terahertz waves
abstract: An analysis of characteristics of terahertz range, possible areas of its implementation and an existent radioelec-tronical element base has been performed and approaches of design of one of the most promising scientific and technological direction — terahertz telecommunications by means of development of digital telecommunication systems for a transmission of ultrahigh-speed (more than 1 Gbps) communication flows have been observed. The alternate designs of a solution of the problem of a construction of a digital system of terahertz range at frequency 130–134 GHz with the use of QPSK modulation and combined QAM\FM modulation have been originated as well as the analysis of their capacity. The requirements to the main parameters of the system have been defined and a testing of their compatibility with the proposed variants of a construction of a digital radio-relay system of terahertz range has been conducted.

articleTitle: Hardware description language and information technology of designing data processing and conversion devices
abstract: Hardware description tools and methods based on FPGA are analyzed. The tabular description language is developed. The procedure of conversion table format THDL to textual format Verilog is built. This procedure is the base for creating automatic THDL-translator. The results of testing confirm the correctness of the proposed procedure of conversion.

articleTitle: Permittivity determination in the T-junction with multimode resonator
abstract: A physical model of microwave measuring of the permittivity on the basis of the waveguide T-junction with the multimode resonator is considered. The rigorous solution of the diffraction problem is obtained in the form of the linear algebraic equations system. Amplitude-frequency characteristics for various relations between wavelengths, geometrical sizes of structure and the material parameters of media are calculated. The practical application of the considered model — the trapped modes regime in the multimode resonator and resonant wave propagation in the medium are selected.

articleTitle: The two-cascade X-range amplifier with 17-W power output on element base of FSUC «R&PC «ISTOK»
abstract: The two-cascade X-range amplifier with output power not less than 17 W, efficiency not less than 25 % is developed on FSUC R&PC «Istok» element base.

articleTitle: Intermodulation distortions in GaAs and SiC class-E power amplifiers
abstract: Third-order intermodulation distortions (IMD) in two different cases of class-E power amplifiers (PA) using GaAs and SiC transistors are investigated.

articleTitle: Determination of potable spring water refractive index by the vibrating string method
abstract: Temperature dependencies of refractive indexes in mm-range of wavelength of potable water samples taken from different springs are investigated by the vibrating string method. The possibility to define potable water belonging to the certain spring using the rectilinear regression coefficient is shown.

articleTitle: The low-dimensional cavity tunable by a magnetic field
abstract: The paper concerns the method for tuning of the low-dimensional system resonance by change in the magnetic field acting on the gallium arsenide crystal integrated into the low-dimensional cavity. The results of the experimental study of the magnetic field effects on the restructuring of the resonant frequency of low-dimensional resonant system are presented.

articleTitle: Double-gap cavity operation in generator-gain klystron
abstract: The operation of a double-gab cavity in a mode when a regime of self-oscillation is combined with a mode of speed electron modulation ensuring subsequent grouping of electron bunch is investigated. It is shown a possibility to reach the first harmonic convection current 1.7/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> in gain unit.

articleTitle: Control of polarization and energetic characteristics of X-like slots in a rectangular waveguide using dielectric inhomogeneities
abstract: A possibility of obtaining high level of ellipticity and radiation coefficients of the field radiated and low level of reflection one from the X-slot using dielectric inhomogeneities in a rectangular waveguide is shown.

articleTitle: The transverse resonance technique modification for analysis of slot resonators in microstrip line ground plane
abstract: The scattering matrix calculation algorithm of a slot resonator in ground plane microstrip by transverse resonance method is obtained. In the modified algorithm of the boundary problem solution for the “electric" and "magnetic" resonator longitudinal harmonics of a current and field harmonics on the slot resonator (i.e. not only half-wave field approximation) are considered It is shown that taking into account higher harmonics it is possible to calculate the scattering matrix elements in microwave range with high precision.

articleTitle: Industrial enterprise — Research and manufacturing association — OJSC «Musson» (in connection with the 45-th business anniversary)
abstract: Brief history of one of the most famous Sevas-topolian radio-technological enterprises — OJSC «Musson» and established on its base Design Bureau of Radio Communication is presented. Descriptions of certain exemplars of radio equipment, produced by the company, are shown. Personaliae of the most prominent specialists of the plant such as I. L. Ka-lyuzhnyy, I. G. Bulychev, A. Yu. Anisimov are given.

articleTitle: Wide-band coherent measurements of the matrix response function of surface traces at X-band
abstract: Coherent experimental measurements of the matrix response function for two surface traces of 24 and 30 km long were carried out.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic properties of ferrites of barium/MWCNTS silicone composites
abstract: The frequency dependences of the permittivity and permeability of composites based on nanopowders hexaferrite and multiwall carbon nanotubes in a matrix of silicone are measured by the resonator method.

articleTitle: Anisotropy of electrochemical porous anodic oxidation of aluminium
abstract: Electric resistance of an aluminum foil was used to monitor its temperature during anodization in the regimes providing porous alumina formation. Current densities higher than 100 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> were found to be accompanied by the sample heating several tens of degrees above the electrolyte temperature. Local heating of different regions in the forming porous nanostructured alumina was calculated to show considerable anisotropy of the effect.

articleTitle: Time-and-frequency synchronization at using the signals of geostationary satellites of SBAS system
abstract: The synchronization method based on the implementation of the “common view” algorithm is discussed. This method can be an alternative to the popular method of comparing the time scales, which is based on a signal SRNS GPS and GLONASS.

articleTitle: Features of architecture of telecommunication network of digital teleradiobroadcasting four digital packages of teleprogram
abstract: Presented as a functional diagram in the generalized kind architecture telecommunication network of digital ether teleradiobroadcasting without laying out of territory on the synchronous areas of broadcasting. Features and place of satellite distributive network of the informative providing are rotined in it.

articleTitle: Modeling of passive millimeter-wave components based on LTCC technology
abstract: The design principles and technology of fabricating millimeter-wave devices based on the technology of LTCC are developed, such as: the folded dipole antenna using metamaterials, the transition from coplanar waveguide to strip-line (CPW-to-SL), the transition from coplanar to coplanar waveguide (CPW-to-CPW), the stripline BPF 60 GHz consisting of mentioned transitions.

articleTitle: Space mapping technique and its application for optimization of the microwave amplifiers
abstract: The approach for modification of the Space Mapping and its joint application with the model transformation method for optimization of microwave devices is presented. The development tools and the results of the optimization of the microwave amplifier of 2÷10 GHz are presented and discussed in details.

articleTitle: Compact antenna electrical axis adjustment accuracy enhancement
abstract: The typical level finding occurred errors, antenna electric axis positioning errors and their causes are analyzed in this article. Method of significant decreasing of systematic errors is proposed for beam alignment.

articleTitle: Stages of synthesis of access networks
abstract: Methods and algorithms of construction of access networks have been developed. Separate procedures have been automatized by means of creating of software products that reduce time and cost of designing.

articleTitle: Distance-to-object measurement
abstract: The approach to distance-to-object measurement is considered. The microwave signal is used for informative parameters obtaining. The use of a homodyne method of frequency transformation is offered. The microwave signal modulates the source of the optical coherent radiation, which is used as a carrier. The given approach to the problem solving assumes the simplicity of equipment realization and, at the same time, provides high metrological characteristics, it makes a serious competition for the modern devices using other measurement methods. Accuracy of the given method is determined by the wavelength of a microwave signal and stability of its frequency.

articleTitle: Development of a phase shifter LSI for radar applications
abstract: An active digital phase-shifter LSI has been developed and tested.

articleTitle: Microwave power of chain of low-voltage vircators
abstract: The output microwave power of a chain of the low-voltage unidirectional coupled vircators have been numerically analyzed by means of 1D PIC simulation (see Fig. 1 which shows dependences of output microwave power on braking potentials for different coupling strengths). We have shown that the output microwave power demonstrates significant growth for certain values of control parameters of the chain of vircators (see Fig.2). As a consequence the efficiency of the system of coupled vircators is higher than the efficiency of single autonomous low-voltage vircators with the same parameters (beam current and braking potential). The obtained results of our numerical study are in good agreement with well-known experimental results (see Ref. 11).

articleTitle: The refraction factor in a millimeter wave band for identification of potable water from natural sources
abstract: Possibility of identification of water from natural sources by the refraction factors measured with using of a method of string fluctuating in a liquid, and a method of capillary-waveguide resonance is shown. By means of simple equipment the offered methods allow defining electric characteristics of liquids operatively. The feature of methods is sufficient sensitivity to change micro water structure that allows using them for diagnostics of quality of potable water and identification of sources.

articleTitle: High-voltage gas switch for high-pressure tests
abstract: Design aspects and test results of high-pressure (60 atm) gas switch incorporating into high-voltage UWB coaxial forming line (with the output voltage of 200-600 kV, and rise-time of 0.2-0.4 ns) are considered.

articleTitle: Yttrium iron garnet magnetically tunable magnetodielectric resonator for millimeter and submillimeter wavelength
abstract: Magnetic field tuning characteristics of a single-crystal yttrium-iron garnet magnetodielectric resonator in the frequency ranges 40–60 and 75–110 GHz are reported. It was experimentally confirmed, that magnetodielectric modes of such resonators are magnetically tunable by 1 GHz with relatively small magnetic field (less then 1.75 kOe). It was pointed that tuning rate and required field can be altered by properly selecting sample's demagnetizing factor. Theoretical calculations on the basis of cylindrical gyromagnetic waveguide theory on H-tuning characteristics of the main dielectric modes give central frequency and maximum frequency splitting in good agreement with the data. It was theoretically predicted, that noticeably magnetic tuning of magnetodielectric modes' frequency will take place over all sub-THz frequency range.

articleTitle: Triple-beam electron optics with magnetic tracking for a high power klystron
abstract: Simulation results for 3-beam magnetic and electron-optic system of a power klystron formed by lined ring cathodes are presented. 3D-features of flow behavior in channels and a collector are considered.

articleTitle: Effective scattering area of aperture antennas
abstract: An experimental and computational model for calculation of the effective scattering area of aperture antennas is described. It allows considering both the antenna and a structural component of the field reradiation. The results of calculations and experimental data for the horn antenna π6-32A are compared.

articleTitle: Technological gyrotron with fast wideband frequency manipulation
abstract: A technological gyrotron with a fast 2% frequency manipulation has been developed, manufactured and tested. Frequency modulation is based on the variation of magnetic field by low power additional coil. The output power up to 10 kW with 20% efficiency has been demonstrated. This gyrotron might be used to increase the ion current of multi charged ions sources (ECRIS).

articleTitle: Service simulating test of microvawe devices included in mismatched paths
abstract: The characteristics of radio-electronic devices is distorted by the influence of complex input/output tract parameters which do not take into consideration during a designing process. The method of estimation of this influence based on a simulation of conditions occurring in the process of inclusion of a device in path with unknown module and a phase of input reflection coefficient is proposed.

articleTitle: Rotation of TE and TM waves vectors in heterogeneous three-dimensional dielectric medium
abstract: The relations for determination of rotation vectors of the electromagnetic field χ and χ′ in a stationary inhomogeneous dielectric medium are obtained. They expand the area of theoretical study of rotation effects in comparison with well-known Rytov's equation.

articleTitle: Millimeter radiowave fluctuations in the atmospheric channel with precipitations
abstract: The millimeter radio wave fluctuation of the 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order calculations are observed in the article. The behavior of the dispersion is analyzed with respect to different parameters.

articleTitle: Optical properties of amorphous hydrogenated Si
abstract: One of the most important properties of any amorphous solid is its optical properties. In this work presented a model for the calculation the spectral dependence of the imaginary part of the dielectric function and absorption coefficient.

articleTitle: Computationally efficient analysis of microwave injection-locked amplifiers
abstract: In this paper, some preliminary results on a novel approach to the analysis of injection-locked amplifiers are presented. The proposed method is based on a behavioral block modeling of the circuit in the fundamental-frequency dynamical phasor domain. The first-order exact perturbation-refined treatment developed provides, in the end, explicit equations describing the entrained oscillation amplitude and phase dynamics. A secondary simplification then can be adopted in case of low-level injection, to determine a closed form expression for the locking bandwidth, generalizing the well known Adler's one. By virtue of its semi-analytical nature, the proposed approach turns out to be much more efficient and less time consuming, for any design and optimization purpose, with respect to the use of conventional circuit simulators, even those operating in the frequency - and not in the time-domain.

articleTitle: Synthesizer of speechlike signals with biometric speaker verification
abstract: The “speech-like” signal generation system containing a speaker verification module for selection of the allo-phone database corresponding to a speaker is developed. The speech segmentation algorithm is developed and realized.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of gas hydrate decomposition under microwave heating
abstract: Numerical studies were performed with the two-dimensional axisymmetric model of gas hydrate decomposition in a porous media under microwave heating. The mass of gas evolved during hydrate dissociation was determined. The calculation of the energy efficiency of electromagnetic heating was carried out. These results are quite usable from a practical standpoint.

articleTitle: Radiation patterns of folded reflector antennas based on reflectarrays of printed elements
abstract: The problems of constructive synthesis of Cassegrain reflector antenna as integral circuit are considered. On a comparison with known constructions of such antennas the offered antenna has a series of advantages, namely, greater adaptability to manufacture of printed elements reflectarrays and more high level of a transparency of a polarizing filter due to the introducing into antenna construction of a ≪clarifying≫ grating. Radiation patterns of Cassegrain reflector antennas based on folded reflectarrays of printed elements are presented.

articleTitle: On methods of heat dissipation and GaN IC amplifier cost decrease
abstract: The report concerns the analysis of engineering and design ways to decrease GaN MIC amplifier cost. GaN quasi-monolithic IC designed on CVD-diamond substrate is shown.

articleTitle: Investigation of X-band LNA with input protection
abstract: LNA and heterostructure pin-diode limiter MMIC's development results are presented.

articleTitle: Transmission characteristics of metal circular waveguides in terahertz range
abstract: Transmission characteristics are investigated theoretically and experimentally for oversized metallic circular waveguides excited by linearly polarized Gaussian beams of radiation in the terahertz range.

articleTitle: Plasma as a conductive medium for traveling-wave antenna
abstract: It is shown that the surface waves of the current propagation in a column of cold isotropic plasma are the source of the paraxial electromagnetic radiation. The influence of the dielectric tube waveguide surrounding the plasma on the dispersion properties of the plasma column is investigated. The corresponding dispersion equation is derived and solved numerically. The plasma and dielectric waveguide parameters are determined, at which the travelling surface wave deceleration is close to unity.

articleTitle: Study of fractal features morphology of surface HEMT GAN heterostructures on foreign substrates
abstract: It was found that as a result of self-affine (fractal) geometry of GaN / AlGaN hetero-epitaxial layers, electrons in DEG-channel HEMT-structures move not in 2D, but in 3D plane. It leads to additional scattering of electrons and the linear resistance depends on DEG-channel source-drain HEMT-transistor size. Self-affine properties of the DEG-channel depend on self-affine (fractal) geometry of GaN buffer layer surface relief, which is replicated by the heteroepitaxial layers of HEMT-structures during epitaxial growth. The strong differences between the fractal geometry of heteroepitaxial layers and the fractal geometry of the surface of the buffer layer leads to a significant increase in their area and, consequently, to changes in the morphology of the surface at the nanoscale.

articleTitle: Luminescence in titania xerogel doped with strontium and terbium
abstract: The paper reports on synthesis and characterization of the structures on the basis of porous anodic alumina with titania xerogel doped with strontium and terbium. Luminescence of the structure and possibility of application the sol-gel synthesis for the X-ray convertor film with reduced size of the grains is discussed.

articleTitle: Two-mode gyrotron
abstract: The possibilities for improving the efficiency of millimeter-wave gyrotron with multimode interaction fields of whispering gallery waves and a relativistic helical electron beam are considered. It is shown that two-mode gyrotron, as compared with a single-mode device allows one to boost the efficiency from 40 to 45%.

articleTitle: Miniaturized diplexers and filters for GLONASS and GPS satellite navigation
abstract: New filters and diplexers for satellite radio navigation system based on low and high pass filters are presented. Each filter has the broad stopband and low signal power losses in the passband. Location of the bands is chosen to cover the GLONASS and GPS band L1 and L2, and provide resolution between each other. In the article the characteristics of diplexers and filters transmission gain are presented as well as the topology calculated in Microwave Office software.

articleTitle: Antenna array spatial structure adaptation to active and intermodulation interferences
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of intermodulation interferences in the receiving path of an active antenna array. The authors have proposed the algorithm of antenna array spatial structure adaptation which allows increasing active and intermodulation interference immunity.

articleTitle: Noise properties of resonant spin-torque microwave detectors
abstract: The analysis of performance of a resonance-type spin-torque microwave detector (STMD) in the presence of noise has been carried out. It reveals the existence of two distinct modes of STMD operation. In the first (high-frequency) mode the minimum detectable microwave power P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub> is limited by the low-frequency Johnson-Nyquist noise and the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of STMD is proportional to the input microwave power P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">RF</sub>. In the second (low-frequency) mode P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub> is limited by the magnetic noise, and the SNR is proportional to P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">RF</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>. The developed formalism can be used for the optimization of the practical noise-handling parameters of a STMD.

articleTitle: Modelling of radio network with adaptive antenna performance
abstract: The results of simulation of performance of a radio network with adaptive antenna by means of planning software of ICS Telecom radio network are given. The main purpose of antenna pattern adaptation is reduction of a level of co-channel interference in a base station receiver of a radio network.

articleTitle: Creating orthogonal ensembles of discrete noise signals using linear transformations of special form
abstract: A system of linear transformation with maximum number of elements was created. This system allows getting the ensemble of orthogonal signals based on any non-zero signal. A method of getting real matrix representations of current transformations system for the space dimensions, which are powers of two, is represented. Those transformations proposed to be used while creating a code division multiple access communication system, which are based on autocorrelation reception of noisy signals.

articleTitle: An approximate solution of wave diffraction by a wedge with a perfectly conducting faces
abstract: The approximate solution of the diffraction of a spherical wave radiated by an elementary electric dipole on a wedge with perfectly conducting faces is presented. The comparison of calculated scattering patterns of the dipole field over the wedge surface, calculated from the asymptotic formulas with measured on the model of the wedge is made. The diagrams of the scattering in the geometrical optics.

articleTitle: Method of synthesis of approaches to measurement of mass flow rate of substances
abstract: The new principle for development of a microwave meter of mass flow rate of pipeline substances is proposed. It improves the accuracy of measurements.

articleTitle: Microwave detection of borders of delaminations in dielectric materials
abstract: A nondestructive methods for testing of parameters of delaminations in layered structures is developed. This method is based on microwave multifrequency sensing and solving an inverse scattering problem in order to determine thickness of layers in the structure. An approach to identification of boundary of the delamination is proposed and its experimental testing is performed for longitudinal scanning of the structure.

articleTitle: The coaxial resonator of shortening capacity
abstract: This paper considers the design of the coaxial resonator of shortening capacity for determining moisture content in biological objects.

articleTitle: Electrothermal processes in conducting films of metal-dielectric structures under influence of powerful electromagnetic fields
abstract: Results of estimated calculations of energy and time necessary for fusion of a metal film of the metal-dielectric structure under influence of powerful electromagnetic fields are resulted.

articleTitle: Analysis of videoinformation on basis of eyes movement tracking technology for apply in telecommunication systems
abstract: It is shown that method of fractal dimension used for characteristic of complex geometry objects may be applied in the eyes trajectory analysis for detection of individual features of video information perception by various observers. Taking into account specific eyes movements on reading information in telecommunication systems enables creating more effective information technologies subject to the features of cognitive processes.

articleTitle: Detectors with Schottky barrier on the basis of A2B6 semiconductors
abstract: The issues of manufacturing technology of Schottky diodes based on promising compounds A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> and their current-voltage characteristics for metallic contacts of Ni, Pt, Pd are discussed. The current-voltage characteristics of experimental samples of photodiodes based on ZnSe under the influence of optical radiation are shown. It was found that the sensitivity of the diodes with platinum contacts is 2–3 times higher than the diodes with contacts made of nickel and palladium under UV irradiation. The analysis of collection efficiency of nonequilibrium carriers in the compounds of ZnSe, ZnTe, CdSe, CdTe is presented.

articleTitle: Engineering of low-frequency and low-noise MEFSET average-capacity with regard for fractal properties of gallium arsenide epitaxial layers
abstract: The result showed that consideration of n-GaAs epitaxial layer fractal properties allows one to obtain better instrument characteristics in the process of engineering and manufacturing of 0.01–1 GHz low-noise MOFSET of average power 100–500 mW: smaller noise coefficient and higher gain coefficient Cg>25 dB (transconductance of G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">M</inf>>180 mS/mm) at a longer gate L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf>=1 microns. The results thus indicated the effectiveness of the fractal approach in the process of engineering low-frequency average power MEFSET.

articleTitle: Radio measuring equipment from Rohde & Schwarz
abstract: Company Rohde & Schwarz (Germany) is one of the international leaders in development and production of radio measuring, broadcasting equipment, radio monitoring and communication technique for commercial and military applications. The company has more than 75 years of business history, more than 90 representative offices in more than 70 countries. Rohde & Schwarz is interested in working on growing Russian market and extension of cooperation with leading Russian companies. The purpose of this presentation is a short overview of main company results in production of general radio measuring equipment.

articleTitle: Simplified coupling matrix synthesis techniques for microwave filters
abstract: The methods are presented for the coupling matrix synthesis of single — and double-terminated microwave filters with Chebyshev response, having a folded or in-line form with prescribed finite-position transmission zeros.

articleTitle: Electric tunable resonator for microwave devices based on hexaferrite-piezoelectrc layered structure
abstract: Studies were performed on bilayers with single crystal Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Y-type hexaferrite and piezoelectrics of Lead Zirconate Titanate or Lead Magnesium Niobate - Lead Titan-ate. The strength of microwave magnetoelectric interactions through ferromagnetic resonance in the bilayers structure is reported. The samples were positioned in a microstripline structure based on alumina. Resonance profiles were obtained for E=0-12 kV/cm; bias magnetic fields H were parallel to the basal plane of hexaferrite.

articleTitle: On design peculiarities of TV high-power transmitters
abstract: Some arising questions are considered at designing and adjustment of TV transmitters with a range of target power values from 100 W to 4 kW.

articleTitle: Modeling of passive gratings with nonlinear loads by volterra series
abstract: Application of Volterra series made it possible to develop an appropriate model for a nonlinear radar facility investigations of the mathematical model to estimate the influence of nonlinear radar on the formation and dispersal of an unmasking signal. The model also takes into account the physical the processes in a semiconductor when subjected to a microwave field of a nonlinear radar.

articleTitle: Microwave radiometer for lunar lander
abstract: A problem of water searching on the Moon surface is discussed. An effect of the Moon regolith regelation in presence of water is investigated. The possibility of using a multichannel microwave radiometer is shown. The radiometer design and specification were discussed. The radiometer is intended to install in future on the board of a Russian Moon lander.

articleTitle: Characteristics of MOS-transistor on basis of silicon-carbon nanotube
abstract: The MOS transistor model on the basis of silicon-carbon nanotube (SiCNT) has been designed. The nanotube has been used as the semiconductor channel of model of the transistor. It has indices (6.0) and width of a bandgap 0.7 eV. The silicon dioxide (SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) layer by thickness of 2.2 nm has been used as the undergate insulator. In calculations of characteristics of the transistor a method of the self-consistent field of electrical potential and the step density of quantum states have been used.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillations of magnetization of single-domain nanodisk at heating by impulses of laser radiation
abstract: We have performed the simulation of switching of magnetization in a ferromagnetic single-domain particle, when it is heated by a single impulse of laser radiation. It is shown that switching of magnetization is accompanied by damped microwave oscillations with a duration of a few nanoseconds. The frequency, the duration and a mode of these oscillations depend on geometrical sizes, the crystallographic orientation and the initial temperature of a disk.

articleTitle: Adaptive inertial strapdown system (ISS) adjusted by GPS signal
abstract: ISS with adaptive architecture using laser gyros with programmable systems of information provision and extraction, is presented in this report. Such an approach allows simplifying the design process, setup and calibration, as well as adopting the new application without substantial alteration of hardware components.

articleTitle: Communication with use of symbolic dynamics of chaotic systems
abstract: The method of the hidden information transmission is offered with the use of high-quality chaotic synchronization and symbolic dynamic of chaotic orbits. The tent map is used as a chaotic system.

articleTitle: GaN-InN gann diodes characteristics in biharmonic mode
abstract: The results of researches of power characteristics for Gunn-diode on the base of the alloy variband semiconductor GaN-InN with different active lengths in the biharmonic mode are presented. The influence of the region between GaN and InN length, cathodes contact and frequency on the diodes efficiency is studied. The possibility of efficient operation for Gunn diodes on the second harmonic in terahertz's range is shown.

articleTitle: Investigation into factors, affecting the control of microstrip transfer line characteristics on a semicondactor substrate
abstract: The results from numerical simulation of the frequency characteristics of the controlled microstrip line on the semiconductor substrate (MLSS) over the 5 to 7 GHz frequency range are presented. This line contains the gallium arsenide or a silicon active layer which changes the electrophysical parameters are reason of control power transmission coefficient through section of MLSS. In this communication the comparison results of numerical simulations of phase-frequency and amplitude-frequency response curves for the power transmission coefficient through the section of MLSS with frequency responses curves of complex constant propagation are presented. We note the disparity between the frequency of phase-frequency and transmission coefficient trends.

articleTitle: Microwave sensor for noncontact measurements of semiconductors
abstract: The microwave sensor for measuring semiconductor parameters by non-contact microwave method has been developed. The results of the minority carrier lifetime (MCL) measurements in silicon using this sensor have been compared with the measurements made using the microstrip sensor of the previously known design [1]. It has been shown that when measuring MCL of the monocrystalline silicon samples with resistivity of more than 10 Ohm×cm, the obtained results are almost not different from the data obtained using microstrip microwave sensor, whose design is suggested in [1]. However, when measuring MCL of the multicrystalline silicon samples with resistivity of less than 0.5 Ohm×cm the sensitivity of the sensor suggested in [2] is significantly higher, to result in increasing accuracy of the MCL measurements.
